scripts.text:
[Errende]
Why, hello there~
Isn't the weather
especially pleasant today?
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
哎呀，你好呀~
今天的天气
格外宜人呢？

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Ah~ There are only two things that can make this picturesque moment even more beautiful: story and song. Now then, which would you like to hear?
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
啊~能让这如画美景更添风采的，只有故事和歌声了。那么，您想听哪一个呢？

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Hmmm?
Is that the seal of black...? Huh. Kino Kitty removed the one he gave me without a trace, so I surmise that he likes you a lot. Otherwise...
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
嗯？
那是黑色的印记...？哈。基诺·基蒂把我给他的那个抹得干干净净，看来他很喜欢你。不然的话...

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou give Errende the letter
you have received from Kino Kitty.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF您将收到的基诺·基蒂的信件
交给了艾伦德。^000000

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Er, he knows everything already? From this spot of blood, I think he still has health problems. He should stop torturing himself...
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
呃，他已经知道一切了？从这血迹来看，我觉得他的身体还是有问题。他应该停止折磨自己了...

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Thank you, I really appreciate what you've done for me. But, what would be an appropriate way to express my gratitude for an adventurer like yourself?
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
谢谢您，我非常感激您为我所做的一切。但是，对于像您这样的冒险者，什么样的方式才能表达我的谢意呢？

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Ah, so how did it go?
Wait, you already found it?
Yes, this is it! Great!
This is so amazing!!
Ah, yes, right.
Right.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
啊，那么，结果如何？
等等，您已经找到了？
是的，就是这个！太棒了！
这真是太神奇了！！
啊，是的，没错。
没错。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
I would like to express my gratitute. But, what would be appropriate for an adventurer
like yourself?
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
我想表达我的感激之情。但是，对于像您这样的冒险者，什么样的方式才合适呢？

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Oh~! I have just the thing. Alright, please make yourself comfortable, and listen to my song.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
哦~！我正好有个主意。好了，请坐舒服点，听我唱首歌吧。

scripts.text:
^483D8BEvery god never grows old
Because of beautiful
Goddess, Idun.
Keeper of the apples of youth
Goddess of immortality.^000000
scripts.translation:
^483D8B众神永不衰老
皆因美丽的
女神伊登。
青春之果的守护者
永生女神。^000000

scripts.text:
^483D8BEvery god never grows old.
Idun, the wife of Bragi,
Idun, Odin's daughter in law~
The apples she keeps
In her basket.^000000
scripts.translation:
^483D8B众神永不衰老。
伊登，布拉基的妻子，
伊登，奥丁的儿媳~
她守护着
篮子里的苹果。^000000

scripts.text:
^483D8BWithout Idun,
Every god would
have succumbed to age.
Even Thor, the strongest of gods,
would grow frail, Megingjard would
slip from his waist, and Mjolnir
would never fly again.^000000
scripts.translation:
^483D8B没有伊登，
众神都将
屈服于衰老。
即使是众神中最强的托尔，
也会变得虚弱，雷神腰带
会从腰间滑落，雷神之锤
也将再也无法飞翔。^000000

scripts.text:
^483D8BWithout Idun,
Every god would
have succumbed to age.
Loki was careless once,
and made her lost to the gods.
He was forced to get her back.^000000
scripts.translation:
^483D8B没有伊登，
众神都将
屈服于衰老。
洛基曾一时疏忽，
让她与众神失散。
他被迫将她找回。^000000

scripts.text:
^483D8BMy goddess stands
In the field of Asgard
She hands me fruit from heaven.
You will be loved by every god...
You will be blessed
By every god...^000000
scripts.translation:
^483D8B我的女神伫立
在阿斯加德的田野上
她递给我天界的水果。
您将受到众神的喜爱...
您将受到众神的祝福...^000000

scripts.text:
^483D8BIf you share the
Apple of youth with me
Even a bite of it with
This poor poet.
You will be loved by every god...
You will be blessed
By every god...^000000
scripts.translation:
^483D8B如果你愿意与我分享
青春之果
哪怕只是让
我这贫穷的诗人咬上一口。
您将受到众神的喜爱...
您将受到众神的祝福...^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFWhile listening to his song, you feel at ease, and your thoughts become clearer. You believe that you see the vision of an angel, and you gain some experience points.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF听着他的歌声，您感到身心舒畅，思绪也变得清晰起来。您仿佛看到了天使的幻象，并获得了一些经验值。^000000

scripts.text:
[Errende]
So, how do you feel now? I hope my song has refreshed you. I'm afraid it may not be enough to repay you, but please understand that this is the best way for me to express my gratitude.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
那么，您现在感觉如何？希望我的歌声能让您焕然一新。恐怕这不足以报答您的恩情，但请理解，这是我表达感激之情的最佳方式。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Besides, I've been thinking of you now as my friend, with whom I may candidly speak without any worry. And I think you have a beautiful smile. Am I wrong~? Hahaha~
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
此外，我现在已将您视为朋友，可以毫无顾虑地与您坦诚相待。而且我觉得您的笑容很美。我错了吗~？哈哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Errende]
I hope that you'll always remain honest and respectful towards other people, and that you continue to ignore greed for fortune or power.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
希望您能永远保持真诚与尊重，并继续无视对财富或权力的贪婪。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
It seems you haven't found it yet. Well, take your time, I can wait as long as you want. It doesn't really bore me, since waiting seems to be a part of my profession.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
看来您还没找到呢。好吧，慢慢来，我可以等您多久都行。这并不会让我感到无聊，因为等待似乎是我职业的一部分。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Mr. Skezti has a small book store on the book street at the right side of Mineta in Juno. If you show him the seal, he'll help you out.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
斯凯兹蒂先生在朱诺的米内塔右侧书街上开了一家小书店。如果您向他出示封印，他会帮您的忙。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
So, have you met Mr. Kitty?
Ah, in Morocc? He has a chronic disease, but obviously doesn't
seem to care about it.
So what did he say?
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
那么，您见过小猫咪先生了吗？
啊，在莫洛奇？他患有慢性病，但显然毫不在意。
那他说了什么？

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Hm? In Juno?
Then that must be it.
It won't be easy if you want to go visit Mr. Sketzi's book store. Here, let me mark you with
^483D8BThe Seal of Friendship^000000.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
嗯？在朱诺？
那应该就是那里了。
如果您想去拜访斯凯兹蒂先生的书店，恐怕不会太容易。来，让我为您盖上
^483D8B友谊之印^000000。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Give me your left hand.
Now, let me cast a spell...
*Mumble mumble...*
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
请伸出您的左手。
好，让我施展一个法术...
*念念有词...*

scripts.text: ^3355FFOn your left wrist, a crescent shaped mark glowing with a silver light appeared. It's only noticeable when you concentrate on finding it, but it might clearly appear under the moonlight.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF您的左手腕上出现了一个新月形的印记，散发着银色的光芒。只有当您集中注意力寻找时才能注意到它，但在月光下它会清晰可见。^000000

scripts.text:
[Errende]
There you go. Now, you may go to Mr. Sketzi. Remember, you must
show him the Seal of Friendship.
Good luck, now~
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
好了。现在，您可以去找斯凯兹蒂先生了。记住，您必须向他出示友谊之印。
祝您好运~

scripts.text:
[Bard]
^483D8BWhat day is
best for drinking?
La la la~
It's the day of
the earth, the sun
And the moon~
La la la~^000000
scripts.translation:
[诗人]
^483D8B哪一天最适合喝酒？
啦啦啦~
是大地、太阳
和月亮的那一天~
啦啦啦~^000000

scripts.text:
^483D8BLa la la~
I'll only
drink on one day~
So if you'll tell me
when you'll drink
I'll tell you when
I'll drink with you~^000000
scripts.translation:
^483D8B啦啦啦~
我只在一天喝酒~
所以如果你告诉我
你什么时候喝酒
我就告诉你
我什么时候陪你喝~^000000

scripts.text:
^483D8BLet's get together
Yea yea ye-^000000 Hmmmmm...?
scripts.translation:
^483D8B让我们聚在一起
耶耶耶-^000000 嗯嗯嗯...？

scripts.text:
[Bard]
Why, hello there. Oh, have you come to listen to my song and forget your worries?
scripts.translation:
[诗人]
哎呀，你好啊。哦，你是来听我唱歌，忘掉烦恼的吗？

scripts.text: Who are you?
scripts.translation: 你是谁？

scripts.text: Ignore him.
scripts.translation: 无视他

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You seem to be
new around here...
Who are you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你看起来
是新来的...
你是谁？

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Mm? Ah yes. I am merely another wandering poet who goes where the wind takes him. Please call me ^483D8BErrende^000000, the Bard who wishes to please you.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
嗯？啊，是的。我只是一个随风流浪的诗人，风把我吹到哪里我就去哪里。请叫我^483D8B艾伦德^000000，一位希望取悦您的诗人。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
If you will let me, I will tell you of my travels. By your leave,
I will play a song that will help you forget your troubles.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
如果您允许的话，我想告诉您我的旅行经历。请允许我，
我将弹奏一首歌，帮您忘却烦恼。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Waaah, wah~
You can't just ignore me like that! Where's your sense of merriment, your sense of romance?
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
哇啊，哇~
你不能就这样无视我！你的欢乐感呢，你的浪漫感呢？

scripts.text:
[Errende]
How could I forget the song?
I'm worthless as a Bard~!
Please... Just...
Please just leave
me alone.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
我怎么可能忘记那首歌？
我作为一个诗人太没用了~！
请...只是...
请让我
一个人待着。

scripts.text: No problem~
scripts.translation: 没问题~

scripts.text: Is there any way I can help you?
scripts.translation: 有什么我可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Waaaah~! You're so mean!
You're supposed to say, 'Errende, what's wrong? Maybe I can help?'
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
哇啊~！你太坏了！
你应该说，“艾伦德，你怎么了？也许我能帮上忙？”

scripts.text:
[Errende]
I mean, we're supposed
to know each other better
than that. But...
Maybe I was wrong!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
我的意思是，我们
应该比这更了解彼此。但是...
也许我错了！

scripts.text:
[Errende]
*Sob...*
Who made this poor Bard cry by neglecting him? *Sniff* I do believe it was you!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
*抽泣...*
是谁让这位可怜的诗人因为被忽视而哭泣？*吸鼻子* 我相信是你！

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Help me?
Hmmm...
That's it!
Gunther!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
帮我？
嗯...
对了！
冈瑟！

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Let me ask you a favor.
If perchance you happen to meet ^483D8BGunther Doubleharmony^000000, please inform him of my dilemna.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
请帮我一个忙。
如果你碰巧遇到^483D8B冈瑟·双和谐^000000，请告诉他我的困境。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Tell him that ^483D8BMinty Errende^000000 happened to forget a line of the song, ^483D8BAt One, I Fall in Love^000000. The line is called ^483D8B8th love^000000.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
告诉他，^483D8B薄荷·艾伦德^000000不小心忘记了歌曲^483D8B《一见钟情》^000000中的一句歌词。那句歌词叫^483D8B“第八种爱”^000000。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
I beseech you, if you meet him, please ask him of the 8th love and inform me of that lyric immediately~
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
拜托了，如果你见到他，请向他询问“第八种爱”的内容，并立刻告诉我那句歌词~

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Argh...!
Who changed the words of this song anyway? It's really difficult to understand. I wish I could ask the person who changed the words.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
啊...！
到底是谁改了这首歌的歌词？真的很难理解。我真想问问那个改歌词的人。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
This is so frustrating!
Now, I've lost the passion
to sing or play...
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
太让人沮丧了！
现在，我失去了
唱歌或演奏的热情...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Don't you think...
The person would be...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你不觉得...
那个人会是...

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Ah! Of course!
I think you're right!
How could I not think of that?
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
啊！当然！
我觉得你说得对！
我怎么没想到呢？

scripts.text:
[Errende]
It all makes sense now. After all, he used to be a member of the Invincible Single Army. His changes might have been a little mean, since this song used to be about a happy couple...
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
现在一切都说得通了。毕竟，他曾经是“单身军团”的成员。他的改动可能有点刻薄，因为这首歌原本是关于一对幸福的情侣的...

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Ummm...
I'm sorry to ask a favor of you again, but in your travels, do you think you could find the original lyrics for this song? I can wait for it...
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
嗯...
很抱歉又麻烦你了，但在你的旅途中，你能找到这首歌的原始歌词吗？我可以等...

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text: I can, so stop crying.
scripts.translation: 我可以，所以别哭了。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Ah, I guess it was too much to ask of you. My apologies. Don't worry about it, I'll find out some other way.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
啊，我想是我要求太多了。抱歉。别担心，我会用其他方法弄清楚的。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Are you serious?
Oh, thank you so much!
You must be an angel!
An angel that truly understands the heart of a poet!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
你是认真的吗？
哦，太感谢你了！
你一定是一位天使！
一位真正理解诗人心灵的天使！

scripts.text:
[Errende]
I'll pay you back somehow!
Thank you for your trouble
in advance~
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
我一定会报答你的！
提前谢谢你的帮忙~

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Gunther? I don't think he would do this. He always puts lines in his songs like 'doubleharmony for you.' Plus, he's too silly for that.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
冈瑟？我觉得他不会这么做。他总是在歌里加入“为你带来双和谐”这样的歌词。而且，他太天真了，不会做这种事。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Gunther? I don't think he would do this. He always puts lines in his songs like 'doubleharmony for you.' Plus, he's too silly for that.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
冈瑟？我觉得他不会这么做。他总是在歌里加入“为你带来双和谐”这样的歌词。而且，他太天真了，不会做这种事。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Surely you jest!
If I did, why would
I not know what
this song is about?
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
你肯定在开玩笑！
如果是我，我怎么会
不知道这首歌
是关于什么的呢？

scripts.text:
[Errende]
{0}...?
I don't think I know that person. Maybe you misunderstood
something? *Sigh...*
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
{0}...？
我不觉得我认识那个人。也许你误会了什么？*叹气...*

scripts.text:
[Errende]
What was the line...?
How could I forget
the 8th love?
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
那句歌词是...？
我怎么会忘记
“第八种爱”呢？

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Oh...!
These tears just won't stop!
Wh-why must people always treat Bards like this?
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
哦...！
这些眼泪根本停不下来！
为...为什么人们总是这样对待诗人？

scripts.text:
^483D8BWho made
this poor Bard cry?
Who broke his
tender heart of glass?
Shattering his dreams...^000000
scripts.translation:
^483D8B是谁让这位可怜的诗人哭泣？
是谁打碎了他玻璃般脆弱的心？
粉碎了他的梦想...^000000

scripts.text:
^483D8BNo dreams,
No heart,
No love,
No hope
No....^000000
scripts.translation:
^483D8B没有梦想，
没有心，
没有爱，
没有希望，
没有...^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFErrende continues to sing about his personal despair. He seems to be disappointed in your refusal to help him. Of course, you begin to feel sorry for him.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF艾伦德继续唱着关于他个人绝望的歌。他似乎对你拒绝帮助他感到失望。当然，你开始为他感到难过。^000000

scripts.text: Well, I should help him then...
scripts.translation: 好吧，我还是帮他一下吧...

scripts.text: Ignore him anyway.
scripts.translation: 无视他。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey. Hey, Errende. Stop singing this song. It's embarassing, okay? Alright, I'll go find the original song for you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嘿。嘿，艾伦德。别唱这首歌了。这太丢人了，好吗？好吧，我会去帮你找到原曲。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
*Gasp!* Really! Are you sure? Thank you! Thank you so much!
You really do care about
the sadness of a Bard!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
*倒吸一口气！* 真的吗！你确定吗？谢谢！太感谢了！
你真的关心
诗人的悲伤！

scripts.text:
[Errende]
I promise to pay you back as best as I can! I'll wait for you here until you return!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
我保证会尽力报答你！我会在这里等你回来！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou ignore his
heart wrenching song.
But at what cost to your soul?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你无视了他令人心碎的歌曲。
但这对你的灵魂造成了什么代价？^000000

scripts.text:
[Errende]
You don't have anything you want to ask me, do you? If not, would you like to listen to my song...?
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
你没有什么想问我的吧？如果没有，你想听听我的歌吗...？

scripts.text:
^483D8BMiiiiserable...
Noboooody looooves meee
Friends foooooor never...
Ooooooooh wah!^000000

[Errende]
Umm...
I am not sure exactly where Mr. Kitty is. Maybe you might be able to find out at the Monster Museum in Juno? I think he's a member of the Monster Research Organization.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
嗯...
我不太确定小猫咪先生在哪里。也许你可以在朱诺的博物馆找到线索？我想他是魔物研究组织的成员。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
If you're experienced in exploration, you'd know the Monster Research Organization. Recently, many scholars have been wounded as a result of researching monsters.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
如果你擅长探索，你会知道魔物研究组织。最近，许多学者因为研究魔物而受伤。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Because of the dangers of monster research, adventurers are needed to gather the information for the researchers.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
由于魔物研究的危险性，需要冒险者为研究人员收集资讯。

scripts.text:
[Errende]

花瓣在空中飘散。
六见，我坠入爱河~
七见，你坠入爱河~

scripts.text:
[Errende]
At Eight we turn away...
At Nine, love is reborn.
At Ten, my Love is gone.
At Eleven I find out why.
At Twelve I see her new boyfriend?
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
八见，我们转身离去...
九见，爱重获新生。
十见，我的爱消失了。
十一见，我得知了原因。
十二见，我看到了她的新男友？

scripts.text:
[Errende]
At Eight we turn away...
At Nine, love is reborn.
At Ten, my Love is gone.
At Eleven I find out why.
At Twelve I see his new girlfriend?
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
八见，我们转身离去...
九见，爱重获新生。
十见，我的爱消失了。
十一见，我得知了原因。
十二见，我看到了他的新女友？

scripts.text:
[Errende]
...

[Errende]
This...
This cannot be.
This song is supposed to be about love, not a romantic travesty!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
这...
这不可能。
这首歌应该是关于爱的，而不是这种荒谬的闹剧！

scripts.text:
[Errende]
The lyrics. They must have been changed. Did Gunther say anything about this?! Hmmm, but who would change the lyrics...?
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
歌词。肯定是被改过了。冈瑟有没有说过什么？嗯，但谁会去改歌词呢...？

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Ah! Of course!
I think you're right!
How could I not think of that?
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
啊！当然！
我觉得你说得对！
我怎么没想到呢？

scripts.text:
[Errende]
It all makes sense now. After all, he used to be a member of the Invincible Single Army. His changes might have been a little mean, since this song used to be about a happy couple...
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
现在一切都说得通了。毕竟，他曾经是“单身军团”的成员。他的改动可能有点刻薄，因为这首歌原本是关于一对幸福的情侣的...

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Ummm...
I'm sorry to ask a favor of you again, but in your travels, do you think you could find the original lyrics for this song? I can wait for it...
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
嗯...
很抱歉又麻烦你了，但在你的旅途中，你能找到这首歌的原始歌词吗？我可以等...

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text: I can, so stop crying.
scripts.translation: 我可以，所以别哭了。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Ah, I guess it was too much to ask of you. My apologies. Don't worry about it, I'll find out some other way.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
啊，我想是我要求太多了。抱歉。别担心，我会用其他方法弄清楚的。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Are you serious? Oh, thank you so much! You must be an angel! An angel that truly understands the heart of a poet!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
你是认真的吗？太感谢了！你一定是天使！一个真正理解诗人心灵的天使！

scripts.text:
[Errende]
I'll pay you back somehow! Thank you for your trouble in advance~
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
我一定会报答你的！提前谢谢你的帮忙~

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Gunther? I don't think he would do this. He always puts lines in his songs like 'doubleharmony for you.' Plus, he's too silly for that.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
冈瑟？我觉得他不会这么做。他总是在歌里加入“为你带来双和谐”这样的歌词。而且，他太天真了，不会做这种事。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Gunther? I don't think he would do this. He always puts lines in his songs like 'doubleharmony for you.' Plus, he's too silly for that.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
冈瑟？我觉得他不会这么做。他总是在歌里加入“为你带来双和谐”这样的歌词。而且，他太天真了，不会做这种事。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Surely you jest! If I did, why would I not know what this song is about?
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
你肯定在开玩笑吧！如果是我改的，我怎么会不知道这首歌是关于什么的呢？

scripts.text:
[Errende]
{0}...?
I don't think I know that person. Maybe you misunderstood something? *Sigh...*
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
{0}...？
我不认识那个人。也许是你误会了什么？*叹气*

scripts.text:
[Errende]
What was the line...?
How could I forget
the 8th love?
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
那句歌词是...？
我怎么会忘记
“第八种爱”呢？

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Welcome back,
{0}~
What would you like
me to do for you?
Would you like to hear
a tale or listen to a song?
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
欢迎回来，
{0}~
你想让我为你做什么？
你想听故事还是听歌？

scripts.text:
^483D8BWhat day is
best for drinking?
La la la~
It's the day of
the earth, the sun
And the moon~
La la la~^000000
scripts.translation:
^483D8B哪一天
最适合喝酒？
啦啦啦~
是大地、太阳
和月亮的那一天~
啦啦啦~^000000

scripts.text:
^483D8BLa la la~
I'll only
drink on one day~
So if you'll tell me
when you'll drink
I'll tell you when
I'll drink with you~^000000
scripts.translation:
^483D8B啦啦啦~
我只在一天喝酒~
所以如果你告诉我
你什么时候喝酒
我就告诉你
我什么时候陪你喝~^000000

scripts.text:
^483D8BLet's get together
Yea yea ye-^000000 Hmmmmm...?
scripts.translation:
^483D8B让我们聚在一起
耶耶耶-^000000 嗯嗯嗯...？

scripts.text:
[Bard]
Why, hello there. Oh, have you come to listen to my song and forget your worries?
scripts.translation:
[诗人]
哎呀，你好啊。哦，你是来听我唱歌，忘掉烦恼的吗？

scripts.text: Who are you?
scripts.translation: 你是谁？

scripts.text: Ignore him.
scripts.translation: 无视他

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You seem to be
new around here...
Who are you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你看起来
是新来的...
你是谁？

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Mm? Ah yes. I am merely another wandering poet who goes where the wind takes him. Please call me ^483D8BErrende^000000, the Bard who wishes to please you.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
嗯？啊，是的。我只是一个随风流浪的诗人，风把我吹到哪里我就去哪里。请叫我^483D8B艾伦德^000000，一位希望取悦您的诗人。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
If you will let me, I will tell you of my travels. By your leave,
I will play a song that will help you forget your troubles.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
如果您允许的话，我想告诉您我的旅行经历。请允许我，
我将弹奏一首歌，帮您忘却烦恼。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Waaah, wah~
You can't just ignore me like that! Where's your sense of merriment, your sense of romance?
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
哇啊，哇~
你不能就这样无视我！你的欢乐感呢，你的浪漫感呢？

scripts.text: Tell me a story.
scripts.translation: 给我讲个故事。

scripts.text: Would you play a song?
scripts.translation: 你会演奏歌曲吗？

scripts.text: Eh, maybe later.
scripts.translation: 嗯，也许以后再说。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
You like stories, huh? What kind of story would you like me to tell? I'll you whatever I know... Just for you, of course. *Grins*
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
你喜欢听故事，是吗？你想听什么样的故事？我会把我所知道的都告诉你...当然，只为你一个人。*咧嘴笑*

scripts.text: News and rumors~
scripts.translation: 新闻和传闻~

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Hmmm. Then shall we talk about this town, Geffen? Have you ever been to the Pub or the Inn here?
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
嗯。那我们来聊聊这个城镇，吉芬吧？你以前来过这里的酒馆或旅店吗？

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Okay, let me tell you a story about Morocc, city of the desert. Adventurers worth their salt are expected to have explored the city and its surrounding desert.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
好吧，让我给你讲一个关于沙漠之城莫洛奇的故事。值得称道的冒险者都应该探索过这座城市及其周围的沙漠。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Why don't we talk about Alberta? There is a sunken ship developed by an event agency as a place where adventurers may go on expeditions. It seems they're making a lot of money.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
我们为什么不聊聊艾尔贝塔呢？那里有一艘由活动机构开发的沉船，作为冒险者探险的地方。看来他们赚了不少钱。

scripts.text: [Errende]
scripts.translation: [艾伦德]

scripts.text:
[Errende]
I'd be lying if I didn't say that the sisters that work the Pub and Inn are... ^FF6699sensuously captivating^000000.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
如果我说在酒馆和旅店工作的那对姐妹花... ^FF6699风情万种^000000，那绝对不算撒谎。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
The elder one is gorgeous, graceful and carries with her an air of refinement. And the younger one is so cheerful, energetic and so... ^FF6699nubile^000000.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
姐姐美丽优雅，气质高贵。而妹妹则活泼开朗，充满朝气，真是... ^FF6699正值青春^000000。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
But I digress.
Sometimes though,
just sometimes mind you,
they're not as sexy as usual.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
不过，我跑题了。
虽然只是偶尔，
但请相信我，
她们偶尔也会显得不那么性感。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
It seems the spirit of their late father, God bless his soul for siring such hot women, possesses them from time to time.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
看来她们已故父亲的灵魂，上帝保佑他生出了这么漂亮的女儿，时不时会附身于她们身上。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
I guess when someone acts even
a little flirtacious towards those girls, their father's spirit takes over. I should know.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
我想，只要有人对那两位姑娘稍微有点轻浮，她们父亲的灵魂就会接管身体。我可是深有体会。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
I guess a father's love endures forever, even into the afterlife. Of course, I wouldn't know.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
我想，父爱是永恒的，甚至能延续到来世。当然，这只是我的猜测。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Let's see...
Look out for this really shady Merchant that hangs out behind
the Pub in Geffen.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
让我想想...
留意一下那个在吉芬酒馆后面出没的 shady 商人。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Judging from his clothes, he must be from Morocc, which is a lot warmer. That's why he's got a Hood, even though it has no drawstrings, for the cooler weather over here.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
从他的穿着来看，他应该来自气候更温暖的莫洛奇。所以即使这里天气较冷，他也戴着一顶没有抽绳的兜帽。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
I must warn you, don't let him talk you into buying that Hood of his since he's selling it for an outrageous price. He's definitely not trustworthy.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
我必须警告你，别被他忽悠去买那顶兜帽，因为他的价格高得离谱。他绝对不可信。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Lastly, I want to mention the lost city of Geffenia, hidden under the Geffen Tower. I hear some kind of condition is required to enter Geffenia, but I'm not sure.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
最后，我想提一下隐藏在吉芬塔下的失落之城——吉芬尼亚。我听说进入吉芬尼亚需要满足某种条件，但我不太确定。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Geffenia is related to the two attractive ladies I mentioned earlier. It seems their father, William, entered Geffen Tower with a party to exterminate monsters, but he never returned.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
吉芬尼亚与我之前提到的那两位迷人的女士有关。据说她们的父亲威廉曾带领一支队伍进入吉芬塔讨伐魔物，但他再也没有回来。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
It's tragic that he left his family behind in that way. But perhaps, it is more tragic that his spirit scares away anyone interested in those girls.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
他就这样抛下家人，真是令人悲痛。但或许更悲剧的是，他的灵魂吓跑了所有对那两位姑娘感兴趣的人。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
The Sphinx and the Pyramids are especially popular areas of exploration for adventurers. Have you been there before? I haven't yet, but perhaps someday I'll go.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
斯芬克斯和金字塔是冒险者特别喜欢的探索区域。你以前去过那里吗？我还没去过，但也许有一天我会去。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
While I was in Morocc, I found a Merchant that sells Sword Maces to Priests and Priestess. Aside from those, Priests are prohibited from using any kind of weapon with blades.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
我在莫洛奇时，发现了一位向牧师和女祭司出售尖刃铁锤的商人。除了尖刃铁锤，牧师被禁止使用任何带刃的武器。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
I also saw an energetic little boy who kept begging his father to tame a Munak for him. I heard the father speak a bit, and it seems that one of his friends from Morocc is lost in Alberta.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
我还看到一个精力充沛的小男孩，一直缠着他父亲要驯服一只僵尸。我听到他父亲说了几句话，似乎他的一位来自莫洛奇的朋友在艾尔贝塔迷路了。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
In any case, I helped the father with an errand, and he gave me a mysterious box in return. When I opened that box, I found a strange feather. I'm unaware of how it works, though...
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
总之，我帮那位父亲办了件差事，他回赠给我一个神秘的盒子。打开盒子后，我发现了一根奇怪的羽毛。不过我不太清楚它的用法...

scripts.text:
[Errende]
I wonder if that man's friend, Pandger Mayer, ever found
his way back home...
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
不知道那位男士的朋友潘杰·梅耶，是否找到了回家的路...

scripts.text:
[Errende]
When the sunken ship first drifted near Alberta, it was immediately found by one of the Alberta Security Knights.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
当沉船最初漂到艾尔贝塔附近时，立刻被艾尔贝塔的一名安全骑士发现了。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
That Security Knight ventured inside and found an infant deep inside one of the rooms. Next to the baby was a music box.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
那名安全骑士进入船内，在一个房间的深处发现了一个婴儿。婴儿旁边放着一个八音盒。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
This baby was the one and only survivor from the sunken ship. He was brought up in Alberta, although he was treated with contempt when he was a child. He's fine now, but I digress.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
这个婴儿是沉船上唯一的幸存者。他在艾尔贝塔长大，虽然小时候受到过轻视。他现在过得很好，不过我跑题了。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
As for the sunken ship, I'm unsure of whether or not it was a pirate ship. It is said that skeleton monsters wearing pirate costumes roam its remains.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
至于那艘沉船，我不确定它是否是一艘海盗船。据说有穿着海盗服装的邪骸战士在残骸附近游荡。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
One of Alberta's other mysteries is the elusive Turtle Island. It seems that one seafarer has found a dependable route to that place and is giving passage to adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
艾尔贝塔的另一个谜团是难以寻找的海龟岛。似乎有一位航海者找到了一条通往那里的可靠航线，并正在为冒险者提供渡海服务。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Still, it seems Turtle Island is not quite safe. Two squads of Alberta Security Knights have already traveled there, but have not yet returned. Verily, this is cause for concern.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
不过，海龟岛似乎并不完全安全。已经有两批艾尔贝塔安全骑士前往那里，但至今未归。这确实令人担忧。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Still, that didn't stop me from visiting that place. By sheer accident, I found the journal of an adventurer who had already been there. It seems he's a famous scholar now.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
尽管如此，我还是去了一趟那里。纯属偶然，我找到了一位曾去过那里的冒险者的日记。看来他现在是一位著名的学者了。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
In that journal are details about an ultimate swordsman, and the exploration of Turtle Island. I'm sure that anyone seeking treasure in that place will find exciting adventure.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
日记中详细记载了一位终极剑士的故事，以及海龟岛的探索过程。我相信，任何在那里寻找宝物的人都会经历一场激动人心的冒险。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Oh, how disappointing. But promise me that you will drop by later, so that we can share stories and merriment.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
哎呀，真遗憾。但请答应我，稍后再来，这样我们可以一起分享故事和欢乐。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
You recognize my talent, so you deserve to listen to my songs! Now, what would you like to hear? I can play anything you want, you know.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
你认可了我的才华，所以你有资格听我唱歌！那么，你想听什么？你知道的，我可以演奏任何你想听的曲子。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
At last, I've met someone who recognizes my talent! You deserve to listen to my songs! Now, what would you like to hear? I can play anything you want, you know.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
终于，我遇到了一个认可我才华的人！你有资格听我唱歌！那么，你想听什么？你知道的，我可以演奏任何你想听的曲子。

scripts.text: Hmm, any song will do.
scripts.translation: 随便唱一首吧。

scripts.text: Play an upbeat song~!
scripts.translation: 来首欢快的曲子~！

scripts.text: Never mind...
scripts.translation: 算了...

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Alright.
Here we go~
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
好的。
开始咯~

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Ahahaha~
My apologies,
But I cannot offer my services for free. Even a Bard needs zeny to live, wouldn't you agree?
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
啊哈哈~
抱歉，
但我不能免费提供服务。即使是诗人也需要Zeny来生活，你说对吧？

scripts.text:
[Errende]
An upbeat song...?
Hmmm... Let's see.
An upbeat song,
An upbeat song...
Okay, here we go~
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
欢快的曲子...？
嗯...让我想想。
欢快的曲子，
欢快的曲子...
好，开始咯~

scripts.text:
^483D8BValhalla dazzles in gold
The fifth as we know
Is old Glast Heim!
Glorious warriors answer
The summons of Odin.^000000
scripts.translation:
^483D8B瓦尔哈拉闪耀着金光
我们所知的第五座
是古老的格拉斯特海姆！
光荣的战士们回应
奥丁的召唤。^000000

scripts.text:
^483D8BPalace of the dead
With a silver roof~
The third as we know...
Valaskjalf!
Glorious warriors answer
The summons of Odin.^000000
scripts.translation:
^483D8B亡者之宫
顶着银色的屋顶~
我们所知的第三座...
瓦拉斯克亚尔夫！
光荣的战士们回应
奥丁的召唤。^000000

scripts.text:

Eight hundred warriors gather

scripts.translation:
^483D8B瓦尔哈拉宏伟的大厅
五百四十扇门
为英雄的心敞开。
八百名战士聚集
在神的意志之下，
如同一股洪流冲出
那些大门。^000000

scripts.text:
^483D8BGodly warriors

Towards their fate.
With pride and honor,

scripts.translation:
^483D8B神勇的战士们
踏入世界树
走向他们的命运。
带着骄傲与荣誉，
他们接受了瓦利耶的
欢迎。^000000

scripts.text:
^483D8BWarriors fallen in battle
In glorious clashes of red
Death may have come,
But your fame lives on
and your spirit will be
led to Valhalla.^000000
scripts.translation:
^483D8B在战斗中倒下的战士
在红色的光荣交锋中
死亡或许降临，
但你的名声永存，
你的灵魂将被引向
瓦尔哈拉。^000000

scripts.text:
[Errende]
...

[Errende]
You know this song is about a legend regarding Valhalla don't you? Supposedly, more than one place was used as the sacred Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
你知道这首歌是关于瓦尔哈拉的传说吧？据说，不止一个地方被用作神圣的荣誉大厅。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
But only the gods will know if this was true or not. Was a place like Glast Heim really the fifth Valhalla? We humans
may never know
with certainty.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
但这是否属实，恐怕只有神明知晓。
格拉斯特海姆真的就是第五座瓦尔哈拉吗？
我们人类或许永远无法确定。

scripts.text:
^483D8BThe sounds of galloping
Echo in the distance.
A cloud of hazy dust
Fills the setting sun.
Thousands of eyes open
Torches on the castle
Flare like thousands of Ifrits.
scripts.translation:
^483D8B马蹄声在远处回响。
朦胧的尘埃
笼罩着落日。
成千上万双眼睛睁开，
城堡上的火把
像成千上万的伊夫利特般燃烧。

scripts.text:
^483D8BHear the throbbing of my heart,
The blood flowing in my veins.
Feeling the heaviness of my armor.
The enemy has appeared before us.^000000
scripts.translation:
^483D8B听我心跳的搏动，
感受血液在伯仁斯中流淌。
感受盔甲的重量。
敌人已出现在我们面前。^000000

scripts.text:
^483D8BBeat the drums hard, harder!
Courage, soldiers, march forward!
Shout loud, soldiers, louder!
Today will never come back!^000000
scripts.translation:
^483D8B用力敲鼓，更用力！
鼓起勇气，士兵们，向前进！
大声呐喊，士兵们，更响亮！
今天永远不会再回来！^000000

scripts.text:
^483D8BStun the sky
Provoke the earth.
I feel my heartbeat again.
Blow the bugle to
Sway the fortress.
Today will never come back!^000000
scripts.translation:
^483D8B震撼天空，
挑衅大地。
我再次感到心跳加速。
吹响号角，
动摇堡垒。
今天永远不会再回来！^000000

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Ah, this is called 'Drumming in the Battlefield,' which was written by Mr. Iolo. Yes, I rather like this song.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
啊，这首曲子叫《战场上的鼓声》，是伊奥先生写的。嗯，我挺喜欢这首歌的。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Heroic warrior,
Please listen to my song. If you have a flower in hand and are in love, let's count the flower petals as we go along.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
英勇的战士，
请听我唱歌。如果你手中拿着花儿并且正坠入爱河，让我们一边前行一边数花瓣吧。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
My fair lady,
Please listen to my song. If you have a flower in hand and are in love, let's count the flower petals as we go along.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
美丽的女士，
请听我唱歌。如果你手中拿着花儿并且正坠入爱河，让我们一边前行一边数花瓣吧。

scripts.text:
^483D8BAt One, I fall in love.
At Two, you give me your smile.
At Three, I adore your touch.
At Four, a tender kiss.
At Five, we change our minds.
A petal scatters through the air.^000000
scripts.translation:
^483D8B数到一，我坠入爱河。
数到二，你对我微笑。
数到三，我迷恋你的触碰。
数到四，温柔的亲吻。
数到五，我们改变了心意。
一片花瓣在空中飘落。^000000

scripts.text:
^483D8BAt Six, I fall in love~
At Seven, you fall in love~
At Eight~^000000
scripts.translation:
^483D8B数到六，我坠入爱河~
数到七，你坠入爱河~
数到八~^000000

scripts.text:
[Errende]
At eight~
At... Eight...
What was next...?
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
数到八~
数...八...
接下来是什么来着...？

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Oh my...!
What was the next part?!
What was the 8th love?!
How shameful for a Bard
to forget the words
to a song!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
哎呀...！
下一句是什么来着？！
第八种爱是什么？！
作为一个诗人，
竟然忘了歌词，
真丢人！

scripts.text:
[Errende]
I...
I can't bear the humiliation!
Or the suspense of what
happens next...!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
我...
我无法忍受这种羞辱！
也无法忍受接下来会发生什么的悬念...！

scripts.text:
[Errende]
You're an adventurer, aren't you? So you must travel quite a bit? It's embarassing for me to ask,
but I have a favor to ask...!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
你是冒险者，对吧？那你一定经常四处旅行吧？虽然有点不好意思开口，
但我有个忙想请你帮一下...！

scripts.text: Sure, no problem.
scripts.translation: 没问题，包在我身上。

scripts.text: I ain't gonna help you.
scripts.translation: 我才不会帮你呢。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Thank you, so much!
Let's see, who would know?
I've got it! Gunther!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
太感谢了！
让我想想，谁会知道呢？
我想到了！冈瑟！

scripts.text:
[Errende]
If perchance you happen to meet ^483D8BGunther Doubleharmony^000000, please inform him of my dilemna.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
如果你碰巧遇到^483D8B冈瑟·双和谐^000000，请告诉他我的困境。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Tell him that ^483D8BMinty Errende^000000 happened to forget a line of the song, ^483D8BAt One, I Fall in Love^000000. The line is called ^483D8B8th love^000000.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
告诉他，^483D8B薄荷·艾伦德^000000不小心忘记了歌曲^483D8B《一见钟情》^000000中的一句歌词。那句歌词叫^483D8B“第八种爱”^000000。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
I beseech you, if you meet him, please ask him of the 8th love and inform me of that lyric immediately~
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
拜托了，如果你见到他，请向他询问“第八种爱”的内容，并立刻告诉我那句歌词~

scripts.text:
[Errende]
*Sigh...*
I can't remember the 8th part of this song if my life depended on it. And it does~! *Wahhhh~*
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
*叹气...*
就算我的命悬一线，我也记不起这首歌的第八部分了。而且我的命确实悬着呢~！*哇啊啊~*

scripts.text:
^483D8BA good Bard sings
To please his listener.
So do not expect a sad song
That deepens your anguish.^000000
scripts.translation:
^483D8B优秀的诗人歌唱
是为了取悦听众。
所以请不要期待悲伤的歌曲
来加深你的痛苦。^000000

scripts.text:
^483D8BA good Dancer dances
To please her audience.
Shall we dance together?
Just hold my hands.
La la la~ La la la~^000000
scripts.translation:
^483D8B优秀的舞娘起舞
是为了取悦观众。
我们要一起跳舞吗？
请握住我的手。
啦啦啦~ 啦啦啦~^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
By the way...
Why do you guys play
discords sometimes?
It sounds weird
when you do that.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
顺便问一下...
你们为什么有时
会演奏不和谐的音？
那样听起来
很怪异的。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
H-how can you say such a thing, {0}? Have you ever been a Bard before? It's difficult to come up with fresh, original melodies!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
你...你怎么能这么说，{0}？你以前当过诗人吗？创作新颖、原创的旋律是很困难的！

scripts.text:
[Errende]
But of course.
Merriment is best
enjoyed when you
are in the mood for it.
Please come again.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
当然可以。
快乐的心情
最适合享受欢乐。
请随时再来。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Hmm~?
Well, alright. Though, listening to a good story or cheerful song can really do you some good. Alright then, see you later.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦德]
嗯~？
好吧。不过，听一个好听的故事或欢快的歌曲真的会让人心情变好。那么，回头见。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Everything will be
fine in the end, right?
I'll be okay, Jorti will be okay, and she'll be... Oh.
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
一切最终都会好起来的，对吧？
我会没事的，约尔蒂也会没事的，她也会...哦。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
I'm sorry, I was just
muttering to myself.
Is there anything
you want from me?
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
抱歉，我刚才只是在自言自语。
你有什么需要我帮忙的吗？

scripts.text: Tell me a story...
scripts.translation: 给我讲个故事...

scripts.text: Your voice is...
scripts.translation: 你的声音...

scripts.text: No thanks, I appreciate it though.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢你的好意。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Many legends have been passed down as songs. Stories of Gods and tales of brave warriors have all been written as songs.
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
许多传说被传唱为歌曲。众神的故事和勇敢战士的传说，都被写成了歌曲。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Many people love to listen to those songs because they dream of the romantic past. To sing these kinds of songs is the reason people like me exist.
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
许多人喜欢听这些歌曲，因为他们梦想着浪漫的过去。演唱这类歌曲，就是像我这样的人存在的原因。

scripts.text: ^3355FFKino Kitty adjusted the strings on his guitar, and began to sing in a low voice.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF基诺·基蒂调整了吉他的琴弦，开始用低沉的声音歌唱。^000000

scripts.text:
^D43D1ARheingold...
Hidden in the Rhein river.
If made into a ring,
Could rule the world~^000000
scripts.translation:
^D43D1A莱茵黄金...
隐藏在莱茵河中。
若制成指环，
可统治世界~^000000

scripts.text:
^D43D1AProtected by a spell
Cursing its thief
To never find love.
Alberich had known
Nonetheless stole it.
Love was forsaken for power.^000000
scripts.translation:
^D43D1A受咒语保护
诅咒窃取者
永远无法找到真爱。
阿尔贝里希明知故犯
还是偷走了它。
为了力量，抛弃了爱。^000000

scripts.text:
^D43D1AGiants built beautiful Valhalla
Matrimony with Freya
Goddess of beauty
Their supposed payment.
In not receiving it
They forcefully took her.^000000
scripts.translation:
^D43D1A巨人建造了美丽的瓦尔哈拉
与女神芙蕾雅
美丽的女神
作为约定的报酬。
因未能得到
他们强行夺走了她。^000000

scripts.text:
^D43D1AThe gods would
give Alberich's treasure
To the Giants for Freya's return.
Loki tricked Alberich,
Stealing his ring or power.^000000
scripts.translation:
^D43D1A众神将阿尔贝里希的宝藏
交给巨人以换回芙蕾雅。
洛基欺骗了阿尔贝里希，
偷走了他的指环或力量。^000000

scripts.text:
^D43D1ABut Alberich cursed his ring
Before it was returned to him,
Envy and death would
befall its wearers.^000000
scripts.translation:
^D43D1A但阿尔贝里希诅咒了他的指环
在它被归还之前，
嫉妒和死亡将
降临于佩戴者。^000000

scripts.text:
^D43D1AThe ring was given to the giants
Freya was returned to the gods
The giants killed themselves
Fighting over the rheingold,
Victims of
Alberich's curse~^000000
scripts.translation:
^D43D1A指环被交给了巨人
芙蕾雅被归还给众神
巨人自相残杀
争夺莱茵黄金，
成为
阿尔贝里希诅咒的受害者~^000000

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Hmm...
^333333*Cough Cough*^000000
This old song
is about the ring
of the Nibelungs.
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
嗯...
^333333*咳咳*^000000
这首古老的歌
是关于尼伯龙根的指环。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
^333333*Cough Cough*^000000
Hah... I can't sing more than one song nowadays. But did you like it? ^333333*Cough Cough*^000000
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
^333333*咳咳*^000000
哈...我现在一次只能唱一首歌了。不过你喜欢吗？^333333*咳咳*^000000

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Ah...
I do feel like singing a song. You know, every song has its own story. ^333333*Cough Cough*^000000
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
啊...
我确实想唱首歌。你知道吗，每首歌都有它自己的故事。^333333*咳咳*^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFKino Kitty coughed a few times, wiping his mouth with his sleeve. As he adjusts the guitar strings, you notice small stains of blood on his sleeve. Then, he began to sing.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF基诺·基蒂咳了几声，用袖子擦了擦嘴。当他调整吉他琴弦时，你注意到他的袖口上有几处血迹。随后，他开始歌唱。^000000

scripts.text:
^D43D1ABrave hero Siegfried 
Vanquished a mighty dragon	
Its blood coated his skin
Making it impenetrable
Save for one tender spot
Blocked by a single leaf
From a linden tree.^000000
scripts.translation:
^D43D1A英勇的英雄齐格飞
击败了强大的巨龙
龙血覆盖了他的皮肤
使其刀枪不入
除了一个柔软的弱点
被一片树叶遮挡
来自椴树。^000000

scripts.text:
^D43D1ASiegfried was powerful
Clearly invincible, save for
those who knew of his secret.
In the end he was killed, by
A spear flung into his back
set into motion by the wrath
And jealousy of a woman.^000000
scripts.translation:
^D43D1A齐格飞强大无比
显然无人能敌，除了
那些知道他的秘密的人。
最终，他被杀死了，
一支长矛刺入他的背部
由一位女子的愤怒
和嫉妒所驱使。^000000

scripts.text:
[Jorti]
Bravo, Bravo~!
Uncle Kino is the best Bard in the world~! Jorti likes Uncle Kino's singing!
scripts.translation:
[约尔蒂]
太棒了，太棒了~！
基诺叔叔是世界上最棒的诗人~！约尔蒂喜欢基诺叔叔的歌声！

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Thank you, Jorti.
Anytime for my
little princess.
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
谢谢你，约尔蒂。
随时为你服务，
我的小公主。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
This song is about Sigfried, who was invincible, except for a single spot on his back. Just singing this reminds me of the influence women have over the world.
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
这首歌是关于齐格飞的，他刀枪不入，除了背上的一个弱点。光是唱这首歌，就让我想起了女性对世界的影响。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
You want to
listen to a story?
Mmm, let me think...
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
你想听个故事吗？
嗯，让我想想...

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
When you go venture Southwest from Morocc, you will arrive at Fortress Sandarman. Did you know that the fortress is built on a sand hill, which serves as a natural defense?
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
如果你从莫洛奇向西南方向前进，就会到达桑德曼要塞。你知道吗，这座要塞建在一个沙丘上，这构成了天然的防御？

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
When you go South of Sandarman, you will see Paros Lighthouse. East from the Lighthouse, you will see Kokomo Beach. North of the beach is Papuchica Forest.
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
在桑德曼的南边，你会看到帕罗斯灯塔。从灯塔往东，你会看到克克魔海边。在海滩的北边是帕普奇卡森林。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
I'm not boring you, am I? I just wanted to tell you about the village of Umbala, which is above that last place I was telling you about. Have you ever been there?
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
我没在无聊地唠叨吧？我只是想告诉你关于汶巴拉村庄的事，它就在刚才提到的那个地方的上方。你去过那里吗？

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Umbala itself is a pretty interesting place. But I'm really interested in this giant tree in Umbala. I've heard that it leads to Niffheim...
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
汶巴拉本身是个挺有趣的地方。但我对汶巴拉的那棵巨树更感兴趣。我听说它通往尼弗海姆...

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
I wonder...
Could that tree be Yggdrasil? Is it possible that I could meet her in the Niffheim, realm of the dead?
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
我在想...
那棵树会是世界树吗？有没有可能在死者之国尼弗海姆遇见她？

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Oh... Well, I have a chronic disease so I can't speak out loud. I, um, even cough up a little blood. But aside from that, I'm perfectly healthy.
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
哦...嗯，我患有慢性病，所以不能大声说话。我，嗯，甚至还会咳出一点血。但除此之外，我身体很健康。

scripts.text: ^3355FFA look of bitterness momentarily flashed across Kino Kitty's face. He then adjusted his guitar strings and began to play, humming a low tune.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF基诺·基蒂的脸上闪过一丝苦涩。随后他调整了吉他琴弦，开始弹奏，低声哼唱着一段旋律。^000000

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Hmm...?
I wish everyone in the world were as kind and honest as you. If that were the case, there'd be no selfish fights. Hahahahaha~
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
嗯...？
我希望世界上每个人都像你一样善良诚实。如果是那样，就不会有自私的争斗了。哈哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Everything will be
fine in the end, right?
I'll be okay, Jorti will be okay, and she'll be... Oh.
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
一切最终都会好起来的，对吧？
我会没事的，约尔蒂也会没事的，她也会...哦。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
I'm sorry, I was just
muttering to myself.
Is there anything
you want from me?
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
抱歉，我刚才只是在自言自语。
你有什么需要我帮忙的吗？

scripts.text: Tell me a story, or sing something~
scripts.translation: 给我讲个故事，或者唱首歌~

scripts.text: Your voice is...
scripts.translation: 你的声音...

scripts.text: No thanks. I appreciate it, though.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢你的好意。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Ah...
I do feel like singing a song. You know, every song has its own story. ^333333*Cough Cough*^000000
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
啊...
我确实想唱首歌。你知道吗，每首歌都有它自己的故事。^333333*咳咳*^000000

scripts.text:
[Jorti]
Bravo, Bravo~!
Uncle Kino is the best Bard in the world~! Jorti likes Uncle Kino's singing!
scripts.translation:
[约尔蒂]
太棒了，太棒了~！
基诺叔叔是世界上最棒的诗人~！约尔蒂喜欢基诺叔叔的歌声！

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Thank you, Jorti.
Anytime for my
little princess.
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
谢谢你，约尔蒂。
随时为你服务，
我的小公主。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
This song is about Sigfried, who was invincible, except for a single spot on his back. Just singing this reminds me of the influence women have over the world.
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
这首歌是关于齐格飞的，他刀枪不入，除了背上的一个弱点。光是唱这首歌，就让我想起了女性对世界的影响。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Ah...
I do feel like singing a song. You know, every song has its own story. ^333333*Cough Cough*^000000
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
啊...
我确实想唱首歌。你知道吗，每首歌都有它自己的故事。^333333*咳咳*^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFKino Kitty coughed a few times, wiping his mouth with his sleeve. As he adjusts the guitar strings, you notice small stains of blood on his sleeve. Then, he began to sing.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF基诺·基蒂咳了几声，用袖子擦了擦嘴。当他调整吉他琴弦时，你注意到他的袖口上有几处血迹。随后，他开始歌唱。^000000

scripts.text:
^D43D1AI still remember feeling
Your shoulder's warmth
As I leaned on it.
You held my hands
until the final moment.^000000
scripts.translation:
^D43D1A我依然记得
倚靠在你肩头时
那份温暖。
你紧握着我的手
直到最后一刻。^000000

scripts.text:
^D43D1ACrying on the inside,
I saw you off with a smile.
Things would never be the same,
But I'd remember every single
Moment we shared.^000000
scripts.translation:
^D43D1A我在心中哭泣，
却微笑着送你离开。
一切都将不再相同，
但我会铭记
我们共度的每一刻。^000000

scripts.text:
^D43D1AI still remember the clear chimes
Of the Prontera Church Bells
The ice cream we shared in Morocc,
Being chased by bats
In Payon dungeon.^000000
scripts.translation:
^D43D1A我依然记得普隆德拉教堂
清脆的钟声，
我们在莫洛克的冰淇淋，
以及在斐扬地牢
被蝙蝠追逐的日子。^000000

scripts.text:
^D43D1AGazing together at
Comodo's fireworks
Snuggles under the
Gently falling Lutie
Snowflakes...^000000
scripts.translation:
^D43D1A一起凝望
克魔岛的烟花，
在姜饼城
轻柔飘落的雪花下
依偎在一起...^000000

scripts.text:
^D43D1AYour beautiful soul
Will be with Odin.
When the day
Of the dusk comes,
A brand new place
Will be before your eyes.^000000
scripts.translation:
^D43D1A你美丽的灵魂
将与奥丁同在。
当黄昏降临之日，
一片崭新的天地
将展现在你眼前。^000000

scripts.text:
^D43D1AI will remember you forever.
Forget me not, call my name.
I'll hear you, and look to the skies.^000000
scripts.translation:
^D43D1A我会永远记得你。
勿忘我，呼唤我的名字。
我会听见，并仰望天空。^000000

scripts.text:
[Jorti]
Ah, Uncle Kino, isn't this the song my mom always sang? Sing more songs, please! Please~!
scripts.translation:
[约尔蒂]
啊，基诺叔叔，这不是妈妈以前常唱的歌吗？请再唱几首吧！拜托了~！

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
You're right...
She always used to sing this song... ^333333*Cough*^000000 There are always people waiting for their beloved to return...
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
你说得对...
她以前总是唱这首歌... ^333333*咳咳*^000000 总有人在等待心爱的人归来...

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
If you have someone who you've left behind, someone that is waiting for you, make sure you come back to that person. You'll regret it if you don't.
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
如果你心里有牵挂的人，有在等你的人，一定要回到他们身边。如果不这样做，你会后悔的。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
You want to
listen to a story?
Mmm, let me think...
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
你想听个故事吗？
嗯，让我想想...

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
When you go venture Southwest from Morocc, you will arrive at Fortress Sandarman. Did you know that the fortress is built on a sand hill, which serves as a natural defense?
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
如果你从莫洛奇向西南方向前进，就会到达桑德曼要塞。你知道吗，这座要塞建在一个沙丘上，这构成了天然的防御？

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
When you go South of Sandarman, you will see Paros Lighthouse. East from the Lighthouse, you will see Kokomo Beach. North of the beach is Papuchica Forest.
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
在桑德曼的南边，你会看到帕罗斯灯塔。从灯塔往东，你会看到克克魔海边。在海滩的北边是帕普奇卡森林。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
I'm not boring you, am I? I just wanted to tell you about the village of Umbala, which is above that last place I was telling you about. Have you ever been there?
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
我没在无聊地唠叨吧？我只是想告诉你关于汶巴拉村庄的事，它就在刚才提到的那个地方的上方。你去过那里吗？

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Umbala itself is a pretty interesting place. But I'm really interested in this giant tree in Umbala. I've heard that it leads to Niffheim...
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
汶巴拉本身是个挺有趣的地方。但我对汶巴拉的那棵巨树更感兴趣。我听说它通往尼弗海姆...

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
I wonder...
Could that tree be Yggdrasil? Is it possible that I could meet her in the Niffheim, realm of the dead?
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
我在想...
那棵树会是世界树吗？有没有可能在死者之国尼弗海姆遇见她？

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Oh... Well, I have a chronic disease so I can't speak out loud. I, um, even cough up a little blood. But aside from that, I'm perfectly healthy.
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
哦...嗯，我患有慢性病，所以不能大声说话。我，嗯，甚至还会咳出一点血。但除此之外，我身体很健康。

scripts.text: ^3355FFA look of bitterness momentarily flashed across Kino Kitty's face. He then adjusted his guitar strings and began to play, humming a low tune.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF基诺·基蒂的脸上闪过一丝苦涩。随后他调整了吉他琴弦，开始弹奏，低声哼唱着一段旋律。^000000

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Hmm...?
I wish everyone in the world were as kind and honest as you. If that were the case, there'd be no selfish fights. Hahahahaha~
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
嗯...？
我希望世界上每个人都像你一样善良诚实。如果是那样，就不会有自私的争斗了。哈哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Errende must be waiting for you. Although others would be in anguish if they were made to wait, and people like Errende and me wouldn't mind, it's still more polite to hurry when you can.
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
艾伦德一定在等你。虽然别人可能会因为等待而痛苦，像艾伦德和我这样的人虽然不介意，但能快点回去还是更礼貌一些。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
I guess you've met Mr. Sketzi.
By the way, why do you have that look on your face? Didn't find what you were looking for? Haha, would you show me your left hand?
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
我想你见过斯凯齐先生吧。
顺便问一下，你脸上为什么是那种表情？没找到想要的东西吗？哈哈，能让我看看你的左手吗？

scripts.text: Here you go.
scripts.translation: 给您。

scripts.text: Um... No!

[Kino Kitty]
Well, while you were gone,
I remembered the original lyrics to the song. I guess they really are important.
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
好吧，趁你不在的时候，
我想起了这首歌原本的歌词。看来它们真的很重要。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Here, let me give you a letter with the lyrics to Errende. I should also give you my seal so that Errende will know it's me. You don't mind, do you?
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
给你，这是一封写给艾伦德的信，里面写着歌词。我也应该把我的印章给你，这样艾伦德就知道是我写的。你不介意吧？

scripts.text: Yes, I mind!
scripts.translation: 是的，我介意！

scripts.text: No, I don't mind.
scripts.translation: 不，我不介意。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Ah, right.
You already have a seal marked by Errende. Oh well, if you don't want it, what can I do?
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
啊，对了。
你已经有艾伦德标记的印章了。好吧，如果你不想要，我也没办法。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Now, let's see...
How is it supposed to go?
...Lu lu lu...
...La la la...
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
那么，让我想想...
这首歌该怎么唱呢？
...卢 卢 卢...
...拉 拉 拉...

scripts.text:
^D43D1AAt One, I fall in love.
At Two, you give me your smile.
At Three, I adore your touch.
At Four, a tender kiss.
At Five, we change our minds.
A petal scatters through the air.^000000
scripts.translation:
^D43D1A第一拍，我坠入爱河。
第二拍，你对我微笑。
第三拍，我迷恋你的触碰。
第四拍，温柔的吻。
第五拍，我们改变了心意。
一片花瓣在空中飞舞。^000000

scripts.text:
^D43D1AAt Six, I fall in love~
At Seven, you fall in love~
At Eight, we're both in love.
At Nine, you know my heart.
At Ten, I know you've
been waiting for me.^000000
scripts.translation:
^D43D1A第六拍，我坠入爱河~
第七拍，你坠入爱河~
第八拍，我们都坠入爱河。
第九拍，你读懂了我的心。
第十拍，我知道
你一直在等我。^000000

scripts.text:
^D43D1AAt Eleven, a precious
Whisper: 'Will you marry me?'
At Twelve, our two hearts
Are one. 12 petals, our
Love finally blossoms.^000000
scripts.translation:
^D43D1A第十一拍，珍贵的
白幽灵低语：“你愿意嫁给我吗？”
第十二拍，我们两颗心
合二为一。12片花瓣，
我们的爱终于绽放。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFAfter the song, Kino smiles at you. You feel a sharp pain on your wrist. On the spot where the silver crescent was, you see a tiny black cross.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF歌曲结束后，基诺对你微笑。你感到手腕一阵刺痛。原本银色新月印记的地方，出现了一个小小的黑色十字。^000000

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
So, how do you like it? Well, I'm certain that Errende will love it for sure. Hahahahaha~ ^333333*Cough Cough*^000000
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
怎么样，喜欢吗？我相信艾伦德一定会喜欢的。哈哈哈哈哈~ ^333333*咳咳*^000000

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
I want to apologize.
I didn't mean to make you wait, but I just remembered the old lyrics to the song. Now, hurry to Errende, I'm sure he's waiting.
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
我想向你道歉。
我不是故意让你久等的，只是突然想起了这首歌的旧歌词。现在，快去艾伦德那里吧，我相信他正在等你。

scripts.text:
^3355FFKino Kitty hands you a letter that is labeled 'Dear Errende'
on the front.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF基诺·基蒂递给你一封信，信封上写着“致艾伦德”。^000000

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Hmmm...?
There's no reason to be scared.
I mean, I won't bite or anything.
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
嗯...？
没什么好怕的。
我是说，我又不会咬人什么的。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Didn't you leave already?
I'm sure you can find the lyrics in a bookstore in Juno.
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
你不是已经走了吗？
我相信你可以在朱诺的书店里找到歌词。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Well, I'm sure Errende knows more about bookstores, so he can probably tell you where to look in Juno. Why don't you ask Errende?
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
嗯，我相信艾伦德对书店更了解，他应该能告诉你在朱诺哪里找。你不妨问问艾伦德？

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
If you don't mind, please come again and listen to this poor Bard's songs. I'll prepare a song just for you.
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
如果不介意的话，请再来听这位可怜的诗人的歌吧。我会为你准备一首歌。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Don't worry about my health. I'm a Bard at heart, and I can't help but sing for my audience.
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
别担心我的健康。我内心是个诗人，忍不住要为观众歌唱。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Also, I'd like to thank you for helping Errende. He may be a little whiny, but he's a good person.
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
另外，我想感谢你对艾伦德的帮助。他可能有点爱抱怨，但他是个好人。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
A silver seal...?
Well, welcome to the wanderer's club. I must say, the silver crescent suits you.
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
银色印章...？
嗯，欢迎加入浪姬舞者俱乐部。不得不说，银色新月很适合你。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
If you have that seal, Mr. Sketzi will permit you to read his books full of Norse songs.
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
如果你持有那个印章，斯凯齐先生会允许你阅读他那些充满北欧歌谣的书。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
What business
do you have with me,
my friend?
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
朋友，
你找我有什么事？

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou gave candy to the crying little girl, and relate the problem with the lyrics to Kino Kitty.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你给了哭泣的小女孩糖果，并向基诺·基蒂讲述了歌词的问题。^000000

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Hmm...
I'm insulted that Errende does not like the words I wrote for 'At One, I Fall in Love.' But, I suppose he is a romantic at heart.
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
嗯...
艾伦德不喜欢我为《第一拍，我坠入爱河》写的词，这让我很受伤。不过，我想他内心是个浪漫主义者。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So...
Do you know the
original words
for the song?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那么...
你知道
这首歌的
原始歌词吗？

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
The original lyrics were horrible. There's not enough room in my mind to remember so romantic nonsense. ^333333*Cries*...^000000
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
原始歌词很糟糕。我的脑海里没有空间去记住那些浪漫的胡话。 ^333333*哭泣*...^000000

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Romance is for foolish dreamers!
I refuse to sing or even remember such vapid lyrics!
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
浪漫是愚蠢的梦想家的专利！
我拒绝演唱甚至记住那些空洞的歌词！

scripts.text:
[Jorti]
U-uncle Kino
You're scaring me.
Please don't yell!
It makes me want
to cry...
scripts.translation:
[约尔蒂]
基...基诺叔叔
你吓到我了。
请不要大喊！
这让我想哭...

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Oh...
I'm sorry, princess.
It won't happen again.
Your Unclde Kino will
try to be good
from now on.
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
哦...
对不起，公主。
不会再发生了。
你的基诺叔叔
以后会尽量
表现好的。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
*Sigh...*
Alright, listen.
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
*叹气...*
好了，听我说。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
You'll need an old book of edda lyrics for the original words to the song. All the new books no longer contain the original version.
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
你需要一本记录着埃达歌词的古旧书籍，才能找到这首歌的原始歌词。所有的新书里都不再收录原始版本了。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
I wonder...
How did Errende happen to know the original lyrics? In any case, I'm sorry about all this. I suppose I'm a little jaded.
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
我在想...
艾伦德是怎么知道原始歌词的？不管怎样，我很抱歉发生了这一切。我想我有点世故了。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
You know, maybe you should go to Juno. There's a small book store on the book street, and you can probably find the song in that store.
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
你知道吗，也许你应该去朱诺。在书街上有一家小书店，你大概能在那家店里找到那首歌。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
^333333^333333*Cough Cough*^000000^000000
Wh-why do I have to suffer? Are my final days as a Bard on this earth soon approaching? I feel so pathetic...
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
^333333^333333*咳咳*^000000^000000
为...为什么我要受这种苦？我作为吟游诗人在世的日子快要结束了吗？我觉得自己好可怜...

scripts.text: Tell me a story.
scripts.translation: 给我讲个故事。

scripts.text: Sing a song.
scripts.translation: 唱一首歌。

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
A story? Mmmm...
My throat hurts,
but if you listen,
I will do my best
to relate a tale.
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
故事？嗯...
我的喉咙很痛，
但如果你愿意听，
我会尽力
讲一个故事。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Do you know how Baldur, son of Odin, died? There is a story involving his obsessive mother
and the wicked god, Loki.
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
你知道奥丁的儿子巴德尔是怎么死的吗？有一个故事，涉及他痴迷的母亲
和邪恶的神洛基。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
One night, Baldur had a nightmare where he was cast into the pit of Hell. Upon hearing of this, Baldur's mother Frigg was stricken with panic.
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
一天晚上，巴德尔做了一个梦，梦见自己掉进了地狱的深渊。听到这个消息后，巴德尔的母亲弗丽嘉惊慌失措。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
To prevent tragedy from befalling her son, she made every single object on earth to agree to an oath where they would not harm Baldur.
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
为了防止悲剧降临到儿子身上，她让地球上所有的物体都立下誓言，承诺不会伤害巴德尔。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
^333333*Cough Cough*^000000 And they all got together to ^333333*Wheeeeze*^000000 celebr--^333333^333333*Cough*^000000^000000...

[Jorti]
Uncle Kino...?
Are you okay?....?
scripts.translation:
[约尔蒂]
基诺叔叔...？
你没事吧？....？

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
...Hah...
...Hah...
I'm sorry, but I don't think I can speak for much longer.
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
...哈...
...哈...
抱歉，我想我没法再对话多久了。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Sorry, but I don't feel like singing at the moment. I hope you understand. I want to sing the last song of my life for Jorti...
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
抱歉，我现在不想唱歌。希望你能理解。我想为约尔蒂唱我生命中的最后一首歌...

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
You have no
business with me?
What a shame.
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
你和我
没什么关系？
真遗憾。

scripts.text:
^D43D1AEven in the sandy wind,
Even in the pouring rain,
Even in the falling snow,
I know it's you~^000000
scripts.translation:
^D43D1A即使在沙风中，
即使在倾盆大雨中，
即使在飘落的雪花中，
我知道是你~^000000

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Bard]
...
scripts.translation:
[神秘的吟游诗人]
...

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Bard]
...
......

[Mysterious Bard]
My apologies,
^333333*Cough*^000000 but this is
a private performance
for my little
princess.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的吟游诗人]
抱歉，
^333333*咳*^000000 但这是
为我小公主
的私人演出。

scripts.text: Um, was that a love song?
scripts.translation: 嗯，那是一首情歌吗？

scripts.text: I'm sorry for interrupting you.
scripts.translation: 抱歉打扰了。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Bard]
A...
Love song?!
scripts.translation:
[神秘的吟游诗人]
什...什么？
情歌？！

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Bard]
Love songs are for fools who have never known true love, or never had their hearts broken. Happy songs are fine, but I refuse to sing nonsense!
scripts.translation:
[神秘的吟游诗人]
情歌是那些从未体验过真爱，或者从未心碎过的傻瓜才唱的。欢快的歌没问题，但我拒绝唱那些胡言乱语！

scripts.text:
[Jorti]
Waaaah~!
Uncle Kino,
I'm scared!
I wanna see
my mommy...!
*Cries*
scripts.translation:
[约尔蒂]
哇啊啊~！
基诺叔叔，
我好害怕！
我想找妈妈...！
*哭泣*

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Bard]
There, there,
princess. Don't cry.
Everything's okay.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的吟游诗人]
乖，乖，
小公主。别哭了。
一切都会没事的。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Bard]
There's no reason to be scared. The scary people with swords only use them on monsters, okay?
scripts.translation:
[神秘的吟游诗人]
没什么好怕的。那些拿着剑的可怕的人，只会对魔物使用它们，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Bard]
You don't need to be scared, that person is a servant of God, okay?
scripts.translation:
[神秘的吟游诗人]
不用害怕，那个人是神的仆人，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Bard]
There's no reason to be afraid of this riffraff, your Uncle Kino is here, okay?
scripts.translation:
[神秘的吟游诗人]
不用怕这种小角色，你的基诺叔叔在这里呢，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Bard]
There's no reason to be afraid. I know that person looks scary, but you're a good girl, so you'll be okay.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的吟游诗人]
没什么好怕的。我知道那个人看起来很凶，但你是个好孩子，所以你会没事的。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Bard]
There's no reason to be scared, honey. It's just a Blacksmith.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的吟游诗人]
没什么好怕的，亲爱的。那只是个铁匠而已。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Bard]
There's no reason to be scared. See...? That person won't hurt you.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的吟游诗人]
没什么好怕的。看...？那个人不会伤害你的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Um...
^333333(Wasn't the little girl
scared by your outburst...?)^000000

[Mysterious Bard]
You're such a kind, young person. I will remember your name. I would much appreciate it if you would also remember mine.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的吟游诗人]
你真是个善良的年轻人。我会记住你的名字。如果你也能记住我的名字，我会非常感激。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Bard]
I am known as Kino Kitty. I am a wandering poet who wishes to rediscover wishes and dreams.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的吟游诗人]
人们叫我基诺·基蒂。我是一名流浪诗人，渴望重新发现愿望和梦想。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
When next we meet, I will tell you what I have heard and experienced. That is, I am willing to spend my time with you.
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
下次见面时，我会告诉你我所听到和经历的事情。也就是说，我愿意与你共度时光。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

你真是个善良的年轻人。我会记住你的名字。如果你也能记住我的名字，我会非常感激。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]

scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
下次见面时，我会告诉你我所听到和经历的事情。也就是说，我愿意与你共度时光。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Bard]
Oh, you're most admirable. You truly do respect Bards, don't you?
scripts.translation:
[神秘的吟游诗人]
哦，你真是令人钦佩。你真的很尊重诗人，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Bard]
Now that I think about it, are you look for anything, or is there a reason you wish to speak to me?
scripts.translation:
[神秘的吟游诗人]
现在想想，你是在寻找什么，还是有原因想与我对话？

scripts.text: I'm looking for Kino Kitty...
scripts.translation: 我在找基诺·基蒂...

scripts.text: Nothing, really.
scripts.translation: 没什么特别的。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
How do you
know my name?
Ah, I'm flattered
that my reputation
precedes me.
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
你怎么
知道我的名字？
啊，我的名声
竟然先于我传开了，
真让我受宠若惊。

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou give some candy to the crying girl and relate your tale regarding the lyrics for the song 'At One, I Fall in Love.'^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你给了哭泣的小女孩一些糖果，并讲述了关于歌曲《At One, I Fall in Love》歌词的故事。^000000

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Hmm...
I'm insulted that Errende does not like the words I wrote for 'At One, I Fall in Love.' But, I suppose he is a romantic at heart.
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
嗯...
艾伦德不喜欢我为《第一拍，我坠入爱河》写的词，这让我很受伤。不过，我想他内心是个浪漫主义者。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So...
Do you know the
original words
for the song?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那么...
你知道
这首歌的
原始歌词吗？

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
The original lyrics were horrible. There's not enough room in my mind to remember so romantic nonsense. ^333333*Cries*...^000000
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
原始歌词很糟糕。我的脑海里没有空间去记住那些浪漫的胡话。 ^333333*哭泣*...^000000

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Romance is for foolish dreamers! I refuse to sing or even remember such vapid lyrics!
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
浪漫是愚蠢的梦想家才有的东西！我拒绝演唱，甚至拒绝回忆那些空洞的歌词！

scripts.text:
[Jorti]
U-uncle Kino
You're scaring me.
Please don't yell!
It makes me want
to cry...
scripts.translation:
[约尔蒂]
基...基诺叔叔
你吓到我了。
请不要大喊！
这让我想哭...

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Oh...
I'm sorry, princess. It won't happen again. Your Unclde Kino will try to be good from now on.
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
啊...
对不起，公主。我不会再这样了。基诺叔叔以后会努力表现的。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
*Sigh...*
Alright, listen.
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
*叹气...*
好了，听我说。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
You'll need an old book of edda lyrics for the original words to the song. All the new books no longer contain the original version.
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
你需要一本记录着埃达歌词的古旧书籍，才能找到这首歌的原始歌词。所有的新书里都不再收录原始版本了。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
I wonder...
How did Errende happen to know the original lyrics? In any case, I'm sorry about all this. I supposed I'm a little jaded.
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
我在想...
艾伦德怎么会知道原始歌词呢？不管怎样，对于这一切我很抱歉。我想我大概是有些世故了。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
You know, maybe you should go to Juno. There's a small book store on the book street, and you can probably find the song in that store.
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
你知道吗，也许你应该去朱诺。在书街上有一家小书店，你大概能在那家店里找到那首歌。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
^333333^333333*Cough Cough*^000000^000000
Wh-why do I have to suffer? Are my final days as a Bard on this earth soon approaching? I feel so pathetic...
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
^333333^333333*咳咳*^000000^000000
为...为什么我要受这种苦？我作为吟游诗人在世的日子快要结束了吗？我觉得自己好可怜...

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Bard]
Really now?
That's strange.
You adventurers are always one some kind of adventure, aren't you? I mean, that's the very definition of the word.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的吟游诗人]
真的吗？
真奇怪。
你们冒险者总是在进行某种冒险，不是吗？毕竟，这就是这个词的定义。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
You're such a nice young man. I will remember your name. I would much appreciate it if you would also remember mine.
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
你真是个不错的年轻男子。我会记住你的名字。如果你也能记住我的名字，我会非常感激。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Bard]
I am known as Kino Kitty. I am a wandering poet who wishes to rediscover wishes and dreams.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的吟游诗人]
人们叫我基诺·基蒂。我是一名流浪诗人，渴望重新发现愿望和梦想。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
When next we meet, I will tell you what I have heard and experienced. That is, I am willing to spend my time with you.
scripts.translation:
[基诺·基蒂]
下次见面时，我会告诉你我所听到和经历的事情。也就是说，我愿意与你共度时光。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Bard]
Ah, it is a privilege to meet a noble woman such as yourself. By your leave, I shall give you my name.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的吟游诗人]
啊，能结识像您这样高贵的女士是我的荣幸。请允许我向您介绍我的名字。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Bard]
My lady, fair as wisteria, whose beauty rivals that of the goddess Freya, let me introduce myself as the poor poet who wanders the earth, Kino Kitty. I hope you remember me.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的吟游诗人]
美丽如紫藤的女士，您的美貌可与女神芙蕾雅相媲美。请允许我自我介绍，我是流浪于大地的贫穷诗人，基诺·基蒂。希望您能记住我。

scripts.text:
[Jorti]
Jorti tries not to cry anymore because it hurts Uncle Kino and then he coughs up more blood.
scripts.translation:
[约尔蒂]
约尔蒂试着不再哭了，因为那样会让基诺叔叔难受，然后他会咳出更多的血。

scripts.text:
[Jorti]
I miss my mommy a lot, but I'm worried, it makes Uncle Kino worry a lot too.
scripts.translation:
[约尔蒂]
我很想念妈妈，但我担心这样会让基诺叔叔也很担心。

scripts.text:
[Jorti]
I don't see my mommy and daddy aren't here anymore, and I don't want Uncle Jorti to go away either.
scripts.translation:
[约尔蒂]
我看不到妈妈，爸爸也不在了，我也不想让约尔蒂叔叔离开。

scripts.text:
[Jorti]
Um, I don't remember my daddy, but mommy lives far away, somewhere near the sky. That's what Uncle Kino says.
scripts.translation:
[约尔蒂]
嗯，我不记得爸爸了，但妈妈住在很远的地方，靠近天空的地方。基诺叔叔是这么说的。

scripts.text:
[Jorti]
U-Uncle Kino says we can't go see her yet because there are no flying boats yet...
scripts.translation:
[约尔蒂]
基...基诺叔叔说我们还不能去看她，因为还没有飞艇...

scripts.text:
[Jorti]
La la la...
La la la...
Jorti doesn't cry anymore!
Jorti is going to enjoy Uncle Kino's songs and stories for as long as she can!
scripts.translation:
[约尔蒂]
啦啦啦...
啦啦啦...
约尔蒂不再哭了！
约尔蒂要尽可能长久地享受基诺叔叔的歌和故事！

scripts.text:
[Jorti]
The songs Uncle Kino sings are ones that my mommy used to sing. She's not here, but maybe we can visit her someday!
scripts.translation:
[约尔蒂]
基诺叔叔唱的歌是妈妈以前常唱的。虽然她不在了，但也许有一天我们可以去见她！

scripts.text:
[Jorti]
Hey... The shiny black cross on your hand means you're a friend of Uncle Kino's. So that means, you're my friend too!
scripts.translation:
[约尔蒂]
嘿...你手上那个闪亮的黑色十字架，说明你是基诺叔叔的朋友。那也就是说，你也是我的朋友！

scripts.text:
[Jorti]
Jorti tries not to cry anymore because it hurts Uncle Kino and then he coughs up more blood.
I miss my mommy a lot, but when I'm worried, it makes Uncle Kino worry a lot too.
scripts.translation:
[约尔蒂]
约尔蒂试着不再哭了，因为那样会让基诺叔叔难受，然后他会咳出更多的血。
我很想念妈妈，但当我担心的时候，基诺叔叔也会很担心。

scripts.text:
[Jorti]
My mommy and daddy aren't here anymore, and I don't want Uncle Jorti to go away either.
scripts.translation:
[约尔蒂]
我的妈妈和爸爸都不在了，我也不想让约尔蒂叔叔离开。

scripts.text:
[Jorti]
Um, I don't remember my daddy, but mommy lives far away, somewhere near the sky. That's what Uncle Kino says.
scripts.translation:
[约尔蒂]
嗯，我不记得爸爸了，但妈妈住在很远的地方，靠近天空的地方。基诺叔叔是这么说的。

scripts.text:
[Jorti]
U-Uncle Kino says we can't go see her yet because there are no flying boats yet...
scripts.translation:
[约尔蒂]
基...基诺叔叔说我们还不能去看她，因为还没有飞艇...

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Bard]
Even in the sandy wind,
Even in the pouring rain,
Even in the falling snow,
I know it's--
........
scripts.translation:
[神秘的吟游诗人]
即使在沙风中，
即使在倾盆大雨中，
即使在飘落的雪花中，
我知道那是--
........

scripts.text:
[Jorti]
Uncle...?
Are you okay?
scripts.translation:
[约尔蒂]
叔叔...？
你没事吧？

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Bard]
Hmmm...
I'm sorry, but this is a private performance. This song is only intended for my little Jorti.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的吟游诗人]
嗯...
抱歉，这是一场私人演出。这首歌只唱给我的小约尔蒂听。

scripts.text:
[Sketzi Bundin]
Well, did you find what you were seeking for? Although all we have are old, dusty books, I hope you come by to visit. And please give my regards to your Bard friends.
scripts.translation:
[斯凯齐·邦丁]
那么，你找到你寻找的东西了吗？虽然这里只有些落满灰尘的旧书，但我还是希望你能常来坐坐。另外，请代我向你的诗人朋友们问好。

scripts.text:
[Sketzi Bundin]
Interesting...
You have a black cross seal on your hand. Is Kitty still around? I'm glad to see he's still alive. If you're a friend of his, then you are most welcome here.
scripts.translation:
[斯凯齐·邦丁]
有意思...
你手上有一个黑色的十字印记。小猫咪还在附近吗？很高兴看到他还活着。既然你是他的朋友，那么这里欢迎你。

scripts.text:
[Sketzi Bundin]
Well, well, well. You're here again. So, what kind of books are you seeking today? Of course, all we have are old, dusty tomes full of eddas. Hahahaha~
scripts.translation:
[斯凯齐·邦丁]
哎呀，哎呀，哎呀。你又来了。那么，今天你想找什么样的书呢？当然，我们这里只有些落满灰尘、写满埃达集的旧书。哈哈哈哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Sketzi Bundin]
Welcome.
You must be looking for something special. Well, we have almost every Norse poem, or 'edda.' This is the only place where you can find those kinds of old songs.
scripts.translation:
[斯凯齐·邦丁]
欢迎光临。
你一定是在寻找什么特别的东西吧。嗯，我们这里几乎收藏了所有的北欧诗歌，也就是“埃达集”。这里是唯一能找得到这类古老歌谣的地方。

scripts.text:
[Sketzi Bundin]
However, I cannot show these fragile books to just anybody. For the sake of preservation, I can only show these works to preferred customers.
scripts.translation:
[斯凯齐·邦丁]
不过，我不能把这些脆弱的书籍随便展示给任何人看。为了保存它们，我只能向特定的顾客展示这些作品。

scripts.text: Show him your left hand.
scripts.translation: 展示你的左手

scripts.text: Show him your right hand.
scripts.translation: 展示你的右手

scripts.text:
[Sketzi Bundin]
Ah~! You must be the friend of a high ranking Bard! I see, I see. You must be a friend of Minty Errende.
scripts.translation:
[斯凯齐·邦丁]
啊~！你一定是位高阶诗人的朋友！我明白了，我明白了。你一定是艾伦德·米蒂的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Sketzi Bundin]
So, what is it that you're looking for? Well, I suppose I don't really need to ask that. Hahahaha~
scripts.translation:
[斯凯齐·邦丁]
那么，你在找什么呢？嗯，我想我其实不需要问这个问题。哈哈哈哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Sketzi Bundin]
Please...
Take your time.
I hope you find
what you're
looking for.
scripts.translation:
[斯凯齐·邦丁]
请...
慢慢看。
希望你能找到
你想要的东西。

scripts.text:
[Sketzi Bundin]
Let's see... Okay.
Well, your heartbeat is a little faster than normal. You might want to look into that. You know, for the sake of your health?
scripts.translation:
[斯凯齐·邦丁]
让我看看...好的。
嗯，你的心跳比平时快一点。你可能需要关注一下这方面。你知道的，为了你的健康着想？

scripts.text:
[Sketzi Bundin]
You're not looking for any medical or health related books, are you? I'm sorry, but we don't carry any of those.
scripts.translation:
[斯凯齐·邦丁]
你是在找医疗或健康方面的书吗？很抱歉，我们这里没有这类书。

scripts.text:
[Sketzi Bundin]
Welcome.
You must be looking for something special and rare. But we only carry one kind of book around here.
scripts.translation:
[斯凯齐·邦丁]
欢迎光临。
你一定是在寻找什么特别且稀有的东西。但我们这里只有一种书。

scripts.text:
[Sketzi Bundin]
If you're looking for monster information, why don't you check the Pronrera Library or the Monster Museum here in Juno?
scripts.translation:
[斯凯齐·邦丁]
如果你是在找魔物信息，为什么不看看普隆德拉图书馆，或者朱诺这里的魔物博物馆呢？

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou opened the book. There's a crisp brittleness to the pages, and the letters are faded and barely readable. You can't even identify the author's name.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你打开了书。书页有些脆硬，字迹已经褪色，几乎难以辨认。你甚至无法辨认出作者的名字。^000000

scripts.text:
[Collection of Eddas]
This is a love song. Everyone suffers from unrequited love at least once in their lifetime.
scripts.translation:
[埃达集]
这是一首情歌。每个人一生中至少都会经历一次单恋的痛苦。

scripts.text:
[Collection of Eddas]
At One, I fall in love.
At Two, you give me your smile.
At Three, I adore your touch.
At Four, a tender kiss...
scripts.translation:
[埃达集]
第一，我坠入爱河。
第二，你对我微笑。
第三，我迷恋你的触碰。
第四，温柔的亲吻...

scripts.text:
[Collection of Eddas]
At Five, we change our minds.
A petal scatters through the air.
At Six, I fall in love~
At Seven, you fall in love...
scripts.translation:
[埃达集]
第五，我们改变了心意。
花瓣在空中飘散。
第六，我再次坠入爱河~
第七，你也坠入爱河...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I think this is it...!
I better write it down.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想就是这首了...！
我得把它记下来。

scripts.text:
[Collection of Eddas]
At Eight, we're both in love.
At Nine, you know my heart.
At Ten, I know you've
been waiting for me.
scripts.translation:
[埃达集]
第八，我们双双相爱。
第九，你读懂了我的心。
第十，我知道你

[Wedding Song]
Prontera Sanctuary
Is where all are heading
To celebrate your union
At your most happy wedding.
scripts.translation:
[婚礼之歌]
普隆德拉圣堂
是众人前往之地
庆祝你们的结合
在这最幸福的婚礼上。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Song]
With joy I strum my Lute
As that is my trade
To bring cheerful song
To your wedding parade.
scripts.translation:
[婚礼之歌]
我欢快地拨动鲁特琴
这是我的职业
为你们的婚礼游行
带来欢快的歌声。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Song]
For my songs, pay me
Not Zeny or Gold,
But the smile of the
Bride, if I may
be so bold.
scripts.translation:
[婚礼之歌]
对于我的歌声，请支付
不是Zeny或黄金，
而是新娘的微笑，
如果我不够大胆的话。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Song]
The glistening eyes
Of a beautiful lass
Those lustrous locks
And that firm, supple--
scripts.translation:
[婚礼之歌]
美丽少女闪烁的眼睛
那光泽的秀发
还有那坚实而柔韧的——

scripts.text:
[Wedding Song]
Forgive me, groom!
But she's just so beautiful!
May your union be blessed!
Er, may your wife be dutiful.
scripts.translation:
[婚礼之歌]
请原谅我，新郎！
但她实在太美了！
愿你们的结合蒙受祝福！
呃，愿你的妻子贤惠。

scripts.text:
[Luke's Note]
This song is about a certain Bard who was invited to a wedding ceremony and could not resist the bride's beauty. He ended up singing a song of seduction.
scripts.translation:
[卢克的笔记]
这首歌是关于一位被邀请参加婚礼的诗人，他无法抗拒新娘的美貌。最后他唱了一首诱惑的歌。

scripts.text:
[Luke's Note]
The lyrics, of course, are fictional, and are in no way anecdotal.
scripts.translation:
[卢克的笔记]
当然，歌词是虚构的，并非基于真实事件。

scripts.text:
[Life is a Water Mill]
I chased after fame.
It eluded me.
I ran after happiness
But never caught it.
scripts.translation:
[人生如水车]
我追逐名声。
它却离我而去。
我追逐幸福
却从未抓住它。

scripts.text:
[Life is a Water Mill]
But tomorrow will still
Be there, I'm sure.
Like the Water Mill
In Al De Baran
Which turns as
Life goes on.
scripts.translation:
[人生如水车]
但我确信
明天依然会到来。
就像艾尔帕兰的水车
随着生活的流逝
不停转动。

scripts.text:
[Life is a Water Mill]
Cheer up! Life goes on.
As surely as the Water
Mill turns, tomorrow
Will come.
scripts.translation:
[人生如水车]
振作起来！生活还在继续。
就像水车不停转动一样，
明天终将到来。

scripts.text:
[Luke's Note]
This song was
made to give comfort
to people in despair.
scripts.translation:
[卢克的笔记]
这首歌是为了
安慰绝望中的人们
而创作的。

scripts.text:
[We]
A good Bard sings
To please his listener.
So do not expect a sad song
That deepens your anguish.
scripts.translation:
[我们]
优秀的诗人歌唱
是为了取悦听众。
所以不要期待一首悲伤的歌
来加深你的痛苦。

scripts.text:
[We]
A good Dancer dances
To please her audience.
Shall we dance together?
Just hold my hands.
La la la~ La la la~
scripts.translation:
[我们]
优秀的舞娘起舞
是为了取悦观众。
我们要不要一起跳舞？
只要握住我的手。
啦啦啦~ 啦啦啦~

scripts.text:
[We]
Towner: 'Then why the hell do you guys make discords sometimes?!'
Bard: 'Well... Nobody's perfect!
scripts.translation:
[我们]
镇民：‘那你们为什么有时候还会搞出不和谐音啊？！’
诗人：‘嗯...没有人是完美的嘛！’

scripts.text:
[Luke's Note]
This song is good to be sung during festivals, as the intentional discord encourages the audience to participate. Aside from that, this song is pretty meaningless.
scripts.translation:
[卢克的笔记]
这首歌适合在节日时演唱，因为故意加入的不和谐音能鼓励观众参与互动。除此之外，这首歌其实没什么特别的意义。

This song was written to give courage to soldiers on the battlefield.
scripts.translation:
[战场上的鼓声]
这首歌是为了鼓舞战场上的士兵而创作的。

scripts.text:
[Drumming in the battlefield]
The sounds of galloping
Echo in the distance.
A cloud of hazy dust
scripts.translation:
[战场上的鼓声]
远处传来
战马奔腾的回响。
一片朦胧的尘土

scripts.text:
[Drumming in the battlefield]
Fills the setting sun.
Thousands of eyes open
Torches on the castle
Flare like thousands of Ifrits.
scripts.translation:
[战场上的鼓声]
遮蔽了夕阳。
千双眼睛睁开，
城堡上的火把
像千个伊夫利特般闪耀。

scripts.text:
[Drumming in the battlefield]
Hear the throbbing of my heart,
The blood flowing in my veins.
Feeling the heaviness of my armor.
The enemy has appeared before us.
scripts.translation:
[战场上的鼓声]
听我心脏的搏动，
血液在伯仁斯中奔流。
感受着铠甲的重量。
敌人已出现在我们面前。

scripts.text:
[Drumming in the battlefield]
Beat the drums hard, harder!
Courage, soldiers, march forward!
Shout loud, soldiers, louder!
Today will never come back!
scripts.translation:
[战场上的鼓声]
用力敲鼓，更用力！
鼓起勇气，士兵们，向前冲锋！
大声呐喊，士兵们，更响亮！
今天永远不会再回来！

scripts.text:
[Drumming in the battlefield]
Stun the sky
Provoke the earth,
I feel my heartbeat again.
Blow the bugle to
Sway the fortress.
Today will never come back!
scripts.translation:
[战场上的鼓声]
震慑天空，
挑衅大地，
我再次感到心跳加速。
吹响号角，
动摇要塞。
今天永远不会再回来！

This song praises the golden apples of the goddess Idun. These were the source of the God's power, as it prevented them from growing old.
scripts.translation:
[伊敦之苹果]
这首歌赞美女神伊敦的黄金苹果。这些苹果是众神力量的源泉，因为它们能防止众神衰老。

scripts.text:
[Apple of Idun]
Every god never grows old
Because of beautiful
Goddess, Idun.
Keeper of the apples of youth
Goddess of immortality.
scripts.translation:
[伊敦之苹果]
众神永不衰老，
皆因美丽的女神伊敦。
青春苹果的守护者，
不朽的女神。

scripts.text:
[Apple of Idun]
Every god never grows old.
Idun, the wife of Bragi,
Idun, Odin's daughter in law~
The apples she keeps
In her basket.
scripts.translation:
[伊敦之苹果]
众神永不衰老。
伊敦，布拉基的妻子，
伊敦，奥丁的儿媳~
她篮子里珍藏的苹果。

scripts.text:
[Apple of Idun]
Without Idun,
Every god would
have succumbed to age.
scripts.translation:
[伊敦之苹果]
如果没有伊敦，
众神都将
屈服于岁月的侵蚀。

scripts.text:
[Apple of Idun]
Even Thor, the strongest of gods,
would grow frail, Megingjard would
slip from his waist, and Mjolnir
would never fly again.
scripts.translation:
[伊敦之苹果]
即使是众神中最强大的托尔，
也会变得衰弱，雷神腰带
将从腰间滑落，雷神之锤
也将再也无法飞翔。

scripts.text:
[Apple of Idun]
Without Idun,
Every god would
have succumbed to age.
Loki was careless once,
and made her lost to the gods.
Loki was forced to get her back.
scripts.translation:
[伊敦之苹果]
如果没有伊敦，
众神都将
屈服于岁月的侵蚀。
洛基曾一时疏忽，
让她从众神手中消失。
洛基被迫将她找回。

scripts.text:
[Apple of Idun]
My goddess stands
In the field of Asgard
She hands me fruit from heaven.
You will be loved by every god...
You will be blessed
By every god...
scripts.translation:
[伊敦之苹果]
我的女神伫立
在阿斯加德的田野上，
她递给我来自天界的果实。
你将受到众神的喜爱...
你将受到众神的祝福...

scripts.text:

If you share the
Apple of youth with me
Even a bite of it with
This poor poet.
scripts.translation:

如果你愿意与我分享
青春之苹果，
哪怕只是让
我这个贫穷的诗人咬上一口。
