它的根部浸满了泪水。^000000

scripts.text:
^228B22Death in Hvergelmir.
An evil dragon
Burning its roots
With eternal flame.
The evil dragon Nidhogg
Living between Yggdrasil
and Niffheim.^000000
scripts.translation:
^228B22赫维格尔密尔中的死亡。
一条邪恶的龙
用永恒的火焰
焚烧着它的根部。
邪恶的龙尼德霍格
生活在世界树
和尼弗尔海姆之间。^000000

scripts.text:
^228B22Evergreen Yggdrasil~
Giant ashen tree
reaching for the sky.
Wisdom in its roots
Roots reaching
Mimir's pond.^000000
scripts.translation:
^228B22常青的世界树~
巨大的白蜡树
伸向天空。
它的根部蕴含智慧
根部延伸
至米米尔之泉。^000000

scripts.text:
^228B22Guarded by a wise giant.
Odin sacrificed one
of his eyes for the wisdom.
Heimdall's horn hidden
In Yggdrasil's roots
Will sound one last time
Signaling Ragnarok.^000000
scripts.translation:
^228B22由一位智慧的巨人守护。
奥丁牺牲了一只眼睛
换取智慧。
海姆达尔的号角隐藏
在世界树的根部
它将最后一次吹响
预示仙境传说的到来。^000000

scripts.text:
[Gunther Doubleharmony]
This is a very old story...
Is it truth or fiction? But please don't ask me, I have no idea~!
scripts.translation:
[冈瑟·双和谐]
这是一个非常古老的故事...
它是真实还是虚构？但请别问我，我完全不知道~！

scripts.text:
[Gunther Doubleharmony]
I will sing one of Luke's songs, you know, Luke, one of the greatest Bards of his time? But I changed the words a little bit.
scripts.translation:
[冈瑟·双和谐]
我要唱一首卢克的歌，你知道的，卢克，他那个时代最伟大的诗人之一？不过我把歌词改了一点点。

scripts.text:
^228B22I found it in a drawer.
Old, worn letters
Forming elaborate words.
Sincere reflection
Of a sincere mind.^000000
scripts.translation:
^228B22我在抽屉里发现了它。
古老、磨损的信件
组成精致的词语。
真诚的心
真诚的反思。^000000

scripts.text:
^228B22I found it in a drawer.
Was I really like that once?
Was I really that childish?
My memories are tarnished.
scripts.translation:
^228B22我在抽屉里发现了它。
我曾经真的那样吗？
我曾经真的那么幼稚吗？
我的记忆已经斑驳。

scripts.text:
^228B22I found it in a drawer.
Love I had forgotten.
She never got this letter.
But both of us were too shy.
scripts.translation:
^228B22我在抽屉里发现了它。
我早已遗忘的爱。
她从未收到这封信。
但我们俩都太害羞了。

scripts.text:
^228B22I found it in a drawer.
Love I had forgotten.
I never gave her this letter.
But both of us were too proud.
scripts.translation:
^228B22我在抽屉里发现了它。
我早已遗忘的爱。
我从未把这封信交给她。
但我们俩都太骄傲了。

scripts.text:
[Gunther Doubleharmony]
Do you have anyone in mind? Do you? If you ever write a love letter, you must send it and express yourself.
scripts.translation:
[冈瑟·双和谐]
你有喜欢的人吗？有吗？如果你写了一封情书，一定要寄出去，表达你的心意。

scripts.text:
[Gunther Doubleharmony]
If you've written love letters that you'll never send, throw them away. Throw your goddamn pride away.
scripts.translation:
[冈瑟·双和谐]
如果你写了情书却从未寄出，那就把它们扔掉吧。把你该死的自尊心也扔掉。

scripts.text:
[Gunther Doubleharmony]
Um, have you ever
tasted Comodo cheese?
scripts.translation:
[冈瑟·双和谐]
嗯，你尝过科摩多岛的奶酪吗？

scripts.text:
[Gunther Doubleharmony]
You can only taste it in Comodo, but you need to have a good strong stomach to digest it. Oh! And the cheese has a secret!
scripts.translation:
[冈瑟·双和谐]
只有在科摩多岛才能吃到，但你需要有强健的胃才能消化它。哦！而且这种奶酪还有个秘密！

scripts.text:
[Gunther Doubleharmony]
You ^228B22might^000000 be invulnerable to the power of the doomed swords, which come from the other world, if you eat it!
scripts.translation:
[冈瑟·双和谐]
如果你吃了它，^228B22也许^000000就能免疫来自异世界的诅咒之剑的力量！

scripts.text:
[Gunther Doubleharmony]
Why don't you go taste it if you haven't yet? I tried to taste it once. It was kind of yummy, but then I fainted. Hahahaha~!
scripts.translation:
[冈瑟·双和谐]
如果你还没尝过，为什么不去尝尝呢？我试过一次。味道还不错，但我随后就晕倒了。哈哈哈~！

scripts.text:
[Gunther Doubleharmony]
I was passing Prontera the other day at the place where it used to be the Swordman training ground.
scripts.translation:
[冈瑟·双和谐]
前几天我路过普隆德拉，就是以前剑士训练场的那个地方。

scripts.text:
[Gunther Doubleharmony]
I saw some kid training really really hard and he didn't notice me watching him, so I guess he was really really serious!
scripts.translation:
[冈瑟·双和谐]
我看到一个小男孩在非常非常努力地训练，他都没注意到我在看他，看来他是真的非常非常认真！

scripts.text:
[Gunther Doubleharmony]
He looked like he wanted to be a professional Swordman, but he was also giving his gear away to other Novices.
scripts.translation:
[冈瑟·双和谐]
他看起来想成为职业剑士，但他也在把自己的装备送给其他初心者。

scripts.text:
[Gunther Doubleharmony]
I got bored watching him do the same thing over and over and over again, but I think the Monster Research Organization would like him if I introduced him.
scripts.translation:
[冈瑟·双和谐]
看着他一遍又一遍地重复同样的动作，我看腻了，但我觉得如果我把他介绍给魔物研究组织，他们应该会喜欢他的。

scripts.text:
[Gunther Doubleharmony]
Have you ever been in Lutie,
land of year round snow?
scripts.translation:
[冈瑟·双和谐]
你去过姜饼城吗？
那个终年积雪的地方。

scripts.text:
[Gunther Doubleharmony]
There is a snowman named
SnowySnow and if you met him, you'd know all sorts of things about him like he can talk! It's so strange and mysterious~!
scripts.translation:
[冈瑟·双和谐]
那里有一个叫雪雪的雪人，如果你见到他，你会知道关于他各种各样的事情，比如他会说话！这太奇怪又神秘了~！

scripts.text:
[Gunther Doubleharmony]
He has a mysterious bag where endless gifts come out, and he's got a mysterious past involving some colder town and something about a nasty witch.
scripts.translation:
[冈瑟·双和谐]
他有一个神秘的袋子，里面能拿出无尽的礼物，而且他有一段神秘的过去，涉及某个更寒冷的城镇和一个邪恶的女巫。

scripts.text:
[Gunther Doubleharmony]
But it's okay because he was rescued by some Alchemist and came back to life, but you should go to Lutie if you wanna know more about him, okay?
scripts.translation:
[冈瑟·双和谐]
不过没关系，因为他被一位炼金术士救了出来，重新获得了生命，但如果你想了解更多关于他的事，应该去姜饼城看看，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Gunther Doubleharmony]
You're gonna leave right now and not even listen to me a little bit? Okay, I'm cool, but promise you'll come back and listen to just one of my songs, okay?
scripts.translation:
[冈瑟·双和谐]
你现在就要走，连听我唱一小段都不愿意吗？好吧，我无所谓，但答应我你会回来听我唱一首歌，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Gunther Doubleharmony]
Wow, you're ignoring me, huh? Alright, that's fine by me! Unless you have some kind of problem where you can't talk, then I'm really really sorry.
scripts.translation:
[冈瑟·双和谐]
哇，你在无视我，是吗？好吧，那也没关系！除非你有某种无法说话的困扰，如果是那样，我真的非常非常抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Marlin Putiur]
Welcome to the
Monster Research
Organization.
scripts.translation:
[马林·普蒂尔]
欢迎来到
魔物研究组织。

scripts.text:
[Marlin Putiur]
We are researching monsters based upon information from adventurers in order to efficiently cope with monsters out in the wild.
scripts.translation:
[马林·普蒂尔]
我们根据冒险者提供的信息研究魔物，以便更有效地应对野外出现的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Marlin Putiur]
We're accepting any kind of information related to monsters,
so if you have any news or info, please don't hesitate to submit it to me.
scripts.translation:
[马林·普蒂尔]
我们接受任何与魔物相关的信息，如果您有任何消息或情报，请随时提交给我。

scripts.text:
[Marlin Putiur]
You can use the report documentation form in
this room at your convenience.
scripts.translation:
[马林·普蒂尔]
您可以随时使用本房间内的报告记录表。

scripts.text:
[Marlin Putiur]
Eh...?
Did you just say
you're looking for
someone? Well...
scripts.translation:
[马林·普蒂尔]
呃...？
您刚才说您在找什么人吗？嗯...

scripts.text:
[Marlin Putiur]
Well, if he's a registered
member of this organization,
I can help you.
scripts.translation:
[马林·普蒂尔]
嗯，如果他是本组织的注册会员，
我可以帮您查一下。

scripts.text:
[Marlin Putiur]
What was the name?
Hermite Charles...?
scripts.translation:
[马林·普蒂尔]
他叫什么名字？
隐士 查尔斯...？

scripts.text:
[Marlin Putiur]
Oh, I found him.
Errr, but he didn't submit all of the required information when he applied for membership...
scripts.translation:
[马林·普蒂尔]
哦，我找到了。
呃，但他申请会员时并没有填写所有必填信息...

scripts.text:
[Marlin Putiur]
Oh. He's a Rogue.
Well, that explains everything. Anyway, did you want to see all
the information we have?
scripts.translation:
[马林·普蒂尔]
哦，他是个流氓。
这就说得通了。总之，您想看看我们掌握的所有信息吗？

scripts.text:
^3355FFMarlin shows you
the membership
application card.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF马林向您
展示了
会员卡。^000000

scripts.text:
[Membership Card]
Name: Hermite Charles
Job: Rogue
Sex: Rogue
Address: Yo Mama Street, Prontera
scripts.translation:
[会员卡]
姓名：隐士 查尔斯
职业：流氓
性别：流氓
地址：普隆德拉 你妈街

scripts.text:
[Marlin Putiur]
Unfortunately, we don't have any more information. But I hope this will be helpful to you in some way.
scripts.translation:
[马林·普蒂尔]
很遗憾，我们没有更多其他信息了。但我希望这能在某种程度上对您有所帮助。

scripts.text:
[Marlin Putiur]
Still, it may be a good idea to visit the Rogue Guild. Perhaps
they can help you.
scripts.translation:
[马林·普蒂尔]
不过，也许去流氓公会看看是个好主意。也许他们能帮到您。

scripts.text:
[Marlin Putiur]
We are researching monsters based on information from adventurers in order to efficiently cope with monsters out in the wild.
scripts.translation:
[马林·普蒂尔]
我们根据冒险者提供的信息研究魔物，以便更有效地应对野外出现的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Marlin Putiur]
We're accepting any kind of information related to monsters, so if you have any news or info, please don't hesitate to submit it to me.
scripts.translation:
[马林·普蒂尔]
我们接受任何与魔物相关的信息，如果您有任何消息或情报，请随时提交给我。

scripts.text:
[Marlin Putiur]
You can use the report documentation form in this room at your convenience.
scripts.translation:
[马林·普蒂尔]
您可以随时使用本房间内的报告记录表。

scripts.text:
[Marlin Putiur]
Hmmm?
Adventurers of this organization? Ah, you say you're looking for a Bard?
scripts.translation:
[马林·普蒂尔]
嗯？
本组织的冒险者？啊，您说您在找一位诗人？

scripts.text:
[Marlin Putuir]
Yes, we have a few Bard members who regularly send us information related to monsters.
scripts.translation:
[马林·普图伊尔]
是的，我们有几位诗人成员定期向我们提供与魔物相关的信息。

scripts.text:
[Marlin Putiur]
I also hear the Bards have been helping scholars instill bulletin boards in fields which indicate the location for new adventurers. Would you let me know the full name of the person you're looking for?
scripts.translation:
[马林·普蒂尔]
我还听说诗人们一直在帮助学者在野外设置告示牌，以指示新冒险者的位置。请告诉我您要找的人的全名好吗？

scripts.text:
[Marlin Putiur]
Minty Errende...
Oh yes, I remember him. He told me a while ago that he's heading South, and that he's staying in Geffen now.
scripts.translation:
[马林·普蒂尔]
薄荷 艾伦德...
哦，我想起来了。他之前告诉我他要往南走，现在应该住在吉芬。

scripts.text:
[Marlin Putiur]
He's a very kind, friendly person. Errende's always doing his best to provide us with the information we need. When you get a chance, would you please give him my regards?
scripts.translation:
[马林·普蒂尔]
他是个非常友善、亲切的人。艾伦德总是尽力为我们提供所需的信息。如果您有机会见到他，请代我向他问好。

scripts.text:
[Marlin Putiur]
Kino Kitty, Kino Kitty... Oh, here we are. He sent us a letter that says, 'I will stay in the desert until I find my real self.'
scripts.translation:
[马林·普蒂尔]
基诺·基蒂，基诺·基蒂... 哦，我们到了。他给我们寄了一封信，上面写着：“我会留在沙漠，直到找到真正的自己。”

scripts.text:
[Marlin Putiur]
He doesn't seem healthy, but I guess he's still traveling. Trying seeking him out in Morocc, and give my regards to him if you get the chance.
scripts.translation:
[马林·普蒂尔]
他看起来身体不太好，但我猜他还在旅途中。请尝试在莫洛克寻找他，如果有机会见到他，请代我向他问好。

scripts.text:
[Marlin Putiur]
Ah, are you a friend of Gunther's? Haha, he's a very funny guy, if a little excitable. Let's see, Gunther, Gunther...
scripts.translation:
[马林·普蒂尔]
啊，您是冈瑟的朋友吗？哈哈，他是个很有趣的家伙，虽然有点容易激动。让我想想，冈瑟，冈瑟...

scripts.text:
[Marlin Putiur]
Ah, it says here that he wanted to look around Payon and Alberta. So he'll be at one of those places. I'm sorry I can't be more specific.
scripts.translation:
[马林·普蒂尔]
啊，上面写着他想在斐扬和艾尔贝塔四处看看。所以他应该在那两个地方之一。很抱歉，我无法提供更具体的信息。

scripts.text:
[Marlin Putiur]
 {0}...?
Ummm hmm...
I'm sorry, but we don't have any records for that person.
scripts.translation:
[马林·普蒂尔]
{0}...？
嗯... 嗯...
很抱歉，我们没有那个人的记录。

scripts.text:
[Marlin Putiur]
We are endeavoring to research monsters in this world with the intent to aid each and every adventurer on their journeys.
scripts.translation:
[马林·普蒂尔]
我们正在努力研究这个世界的魔物，旨在帮助每一位冒险者在旅途中。

What is it?
scripts.translation:

呃...？
怎么了？

scripts.text:
[Energetic Young Man]
Oh...!
A beautiful,
young lady~!
scripts.translation:
[精力充沛的年轻人]
哦...！
一位美丽、
年轻的女士~！

scripts.text:
[Energetic Young Man]
Hello there~
My name is Pane.
May I ask yours?
scripts.translation:

你好~
我叫帕内。
请问您怎么称呼？

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

{0}...

scripts.translation:

哦...
{0}...
这是您的名字吗？

scripts.text:
[Energetic Young Man]
^FF6699{0}!
Such a wonderful name!
scripts.translation:
[精力充沛的年轻人]
^FF6699{0}！
多么美妙的名字！

scripts.text:
[Energetic Young Man]
I shall remember your name, my lady. Oh, but I'm so sorry. I'm kind of busy right now. Would you come back later? I'll do my best to please you next time.
scripts.translation:
[精力充沛的年轻人]
我会记住您的名字的，女士。哦，不过非常抱歉。我现在有点忙。您能稍后再来吗？下次我会尽力让您满意的。

scripts.text:
[Energetic Young Man]
Eh, whatever. Oh, but I'm so sorry. I'm kind of busy right now. Would you come back later? I'll do my best to please you next time.
scripts.translation:
[精力充沛的年轻人]
呃，算了。哦，不过非常抱歉。我现在有点忙。您能稍后再来吗？下次我会尽力让您满意的。

[Energetic Young Man]

scripts.translation:
